I went to the Messenger of God (ﷺ), who was in his tent at al-Abtah at the top of Mecca, and did not find him, but found Fatima, and she was harder on me than ʿAli. She said: You shelter the unbelievers and give them protection, and you do this and that! It was not long before the Messenger of God (ﷺ) came, with the dust-glow (rahjat al-ghubar) on his face, and said: “O Fatima, pour me water for washing.” She poured water for him in a basin — as if I can see the trace of dough in it — then screened him with a garment. “He washed, then prayed eight rakʿas in a single garment, crossing its two ends,” — I never saw him pray them before or after. When he finished, I said: O Messenger of God, I gave protection to two in-laws of mine, and my brother ʿAli wanted to kill them. The Messenger of God (ﷺ) said: “That is not for him. We have given protection to whom you protected, and given safety to whom you made safe.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ قَالَ: ثنا يَزِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي زِيَادٍ
records.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ الْحَارِثِ يُحَدِّثُ ⦗ص: 330⦘ عَنْ أُمِّ هَانِئٍ قَالَتْ: «رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَ الْفَتْحِ صَلَّى ثَمَانِ رَكَعَاتٍ فِي ثَوْبٍ وَاحِدٍ مُخَالِفًا بَيْنَ طَرَفِيهِ»
records.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying: Yazid ibn Abi Ziyad narrated to us
records.matn_en: that he heard ʿAbd Allah ibn al-Harith narrating [p. 330] from Umm Hani’, who said: “I saw the Messenger of God (ﷺ) on the day of the Conquest pray eight rakʿas in a single garment, crossing its two ends.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ قَالَ: ثنا عَبْدُ الْكَرِيمِ أَبُو أُمَيَّةَ قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْحَارِثِ وَلَمْ يَقُلْ لَنَا فِيهِ سَمِعْتُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ عَنْ صَلَاةِ الضُّحَى فِي إِمَارَةِ عُثْمَانَ وَأَصْحَابُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مُتَوَافِرُونَ فَلَمْ أَجِدْ أَحَدًا أَثْبَتَ لِي صَلَاةَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَّا أُمُّ هَانِئٍ قَالَتْ: «رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم صَلَّاهَا مَرَّةً وَاحِدَةً يَوْمَ الْفَتْحِ ثَمَانِ رَكَعَاتٍ فِي ثَوْبٍ وَاحِدٍ مُخَالِفًا بَيْنَ طَرَفَيهِ» 335/م- قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْحَارِثِ فَحَدَّثْتُ بِهِ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ فَقَالَ: إِنْ كُنْتُ لَأَمُرُّ عَلَى هَذِهِ الْآيَةِ {يُسَبِّحْنَ بِالْعَشِيِّ وَالْإِشْرَاقِ} [ص: 18] فَأَقُولُ: أَيُّ صَلَاةٍ صَلَاةُ الْإِشْرَاقِ فَهَذِهِ صَلَاةُ الْإِشْرَاقِ
records.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying: ʿAbd al-Karim Abu Umayya narrated to us, saying:
records.matn_en: ʿAbd Allah ibn al-Harith said — and he did not say to us in it “I heard” — I asked about the Duha prayer in the caliphate of ʿUthman, when the companions of the Messenger of God (ﷺ) were numerous, and I found no one who could affirm for me the prayer of the Messenger of God (ﷺ) except Umm Hani’, who said: “I saw the Messenger of God (ﷺ) pray it once, on the day of the Conquest: eight rakʿas in a single garment, crossing its two ends.” 335/m - ʿAbd Allah ibn al-Harith said: I told Ibn ʿAbbas, who said: I used to pass by this verse, “They glorify [God] in the evening and at sunrise (ishraq)” [Q 38:18], and say: What prayer is the prayer of ishraq? This is the prayer of ishraq.

groups.title_en: Hadiths of Khawla bint Hakim, wife of ʿUthman ibn Mazʿun, may God be pleased with her
groups.title_ar: أَحَادِيثُ خَوْلَةَ بِنْتِ حَكِيمٍ امْرَأَةِ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ مَظْعُونٍ رضي الله عنها

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مَيْسَرَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي سُوَيْدٍ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: زَعَمَتِ الْمَرْأَةُ الصَّالِحَةُ خَوْلَةُ بِنْتُ حَكِيمٍ امْرَأَةُ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ مَظْعُونٍ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَرَجَ وَهُوَ مُحْتَضِنٌ أَحَدَ بَنِي ابْنَتِهِ وَهُوَ يَقُولُ «وَاللَّهِ إِنَّكُمْ لَتُجَهِّلُونَ، وَتُجَبِّنُونَ، وَتُبَخِّلُونَ، وَإِنَّكُمْ لَمِنْ رَيْحَانِ اللَّهِ وَإِنَّ آخِرَ وَطْأَةٍ وَطِئَهَا رَبُّ الْعَالَمِينَ بِوَجٍّ»
records.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying: Ibrahim ibn Maysara narrated to us, from Ibn Abi Suwayd, from ʿUmar ibn ʿAbd al-ʿAziz, who said: The righteous woman Khawla bint Hakim, wife of ʿUthman ibn Mazʿun, reported
records.matn_en: that the Messenger of God (ﷺ) came out carrying one of his daughter’s sons, saying: “By God, you make [men] ignorant, cowardly, and miserly; and you are of the sweet basil (rayhan) of God; and the last tread that the Lord of the worlds trod was at Wajj.”

narrators.ar: عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ إِنْسَانٍ
عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ رَبِّهِ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ بِشْرٍ
أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ هِشَامٍ

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ قَالَ ثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ إِنْسَانٍ يَعْنِي ابْنَ إِنْسَانٍ بَطْنٌ مِنَ الْعَرَبِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ رَبِّهِ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ بِشْرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ كَعْبٍ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَهُ يَقُولُ:
records.matn_ar: إِنَّ وَجًّا مُقَدَّسٌ مِنْهُ عَرَجَ الرَّبُّ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ يَوْمَ قَضَى خَلْقَ الْأَرْضِ، قَالَ الْحُمَيْدِيُّ وَجٌّ بِالطَّائِفِ
records.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: ʿAbd Allah ibn al-Harith ibn ʿAbd al-Malik narrated to us, saying: Muhammad ibn ʿAbd Allah ibn Insan — meaning Ibn Insan, a clan of the Arabs — narrated to me, from ʿAbd Allah ibn ʿAbd Rabbih ibn al-Hakam ibn ʿUthman ibn Bishr, from Abu Bakr ibn ʿAbd al-Rahman ibn al-Harith ibn Hisham, from Kaʿb, that he heard him
records.matn_en: say: Wajj is sanctified; from it the Lord ascended to heaven on the day He completed the creation of the earth. Al-Humaydi said: Wajj is in al-Ta’if.

groups.title_en: Hadiths of Umm Khalid bint Khalid ibn Saʿid ibn al-ʿAs, may God be pleased with her
groups.title_ar: أَحَادِيثُ أُمِّ خَالِدٍ بِنْتِ خَالِدِ بْنِ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْعَاصِ رضي الله عنها

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ قَالَ: ثنا إِسْحَاقُ قَالَ: ثنا مُوسَى بْنُ عُقْبَةَ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ أُمَّ خَالِدٍ بِنْتِ خَالِدٍ تَقُولُ «سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَتَعَوَّذُ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ»
records.matn_ar: قَالَ مُوسَى وَلَمْ أَسْمَعْ مِنْ أَحَدٍ سَمِعَ مِنَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم غَيْرَهَا
records.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying: Ishaq narrated to us, saying: Musa ibn ʿUqba narrated to us, saying:
records.matn_en: I heard Umm Khalid bint Khalid say: “I heard the Messenger of God (ﷺ) seeking refuge from the punishment of the grave.” Musa said: And I have not heard from anyone who heard from the Prophet (ﷺ) other than her.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ قَالَ: ثنا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ السَّعِيدِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أُمِّ خَالِدٍ بِنْتِ خَالِدٍ قَالَتْ:
records.matn_ar: قَدِمْتُ مِنْ أَرْضِ الْحَبَشَةِ وَأنا جُوَيْرِيَةٌ فَكَسَانِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَمِيصَةً لَهَا أَعْلَامٌ فَجَعَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَمْسَحُ الْأَعْلَامَ بِيَدِهِ، وَيَقُولُ «سَنَاهُ سَنَاهُ» قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ يَعْنِي حَسَنٌ حَسَنٌ
records.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying: Ishaq ibn Saʿid al-Saʿidi narrated to us, from his father, from Umm Khalid bint Khalid, who said:
records.matn_en: I came from the land of Abyssinia while I was a young girl, and the Messenger of God (ﷺ) clothed me in a striped cloak (khamisa) that had marks on it; the Messenger of God (ﷺ) began to wipe the marks with his hand, saying: “Sanah, sanah.” Abu Bakr said: Meaning “good, good” (hasan hasan).

groups.title_en: Hadith of Umm al-Fadl bint al-Harith, may God be pleased with her
groups.title_ar: حَدِيثُ أُمِّ الْفَضْلِ بِنْتِ الْحَارِثِ رضي الله عنها

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ قَالَ: ثنا الزُّهْرِيُّ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، عَنْ أُمِّهِ أُمِّ الْفَضْلِ قَالَتْ: " سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقْرَأُ فِي الْمَغْرِبِ
records.matn_ar: {وَالْمُرْسَلَاتِ عُرْفًا} [المرسلات: 1] " فَقِيلَ لِسُفْيَانَ فَإِنَّهُمْ يَقُولُونَ تَمَّامُ بْنُ عَبَّاسٍ فَقَالَ: مَا سَمِعْتُ الزُّهْرِيَّ قَطُّ ذَكَرِ تَمَّامًا، مَا قَالَ لَنَا إِلَّا عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ عَنْ أُمِّهِ
records.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying: al-Zuhri narrated to us, from ʿUbayd Allah ibn ʿAbd Allah, from Ibn ʿAbbas, from his mother Umm al-Fadl, who said:
records.matn_en: “I heard the Messenger of God (ﷺ) recite in the Maghrib prayer ‘By the emissaries sent forth in succession’ [Q 77:1].” It was said to Sufyan: They say Tammam ibn ʿAbbas. He said: I never heard al-Zuhri mention Tammam; he told us only from Ibn ʿAbbas, from his mother.

groups.title_en: Hadiths of Umm Ayyub, may God be pleased with her
groups.title_ar: أَحَادِيثُ أُمِّ أَيُّوبَ رضي الله عنها

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ قَالَ: ثنا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي يَزِيدَ قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي أَبِي، أَنَّ أُمَّ أَيُّوبَ الْأَنْصَارِيَّةَ أَخْبَرَتْهُ قَالَتْ:
records.matn_ar: نَزَلَ عَلَيْنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَتَكَلَّفْنَا لَهُ طَعَامًا فِيهِ مِنْ بَعْضِ هَذِهِ الْبُقُولِ فَكَرِهَهُ وَقَالَ لِأَصْحَابِهِ: «كُلُوا فَإِنِّي لَسْتُ كَأَحَدِكُمْ إِنِّي أَكْرَهُ أَنْ أُوذِيَ صَاحِبِي»
records.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying: ʿUbayd Allah ibn Abi Yazid narrated to us, saying: My father informed me that Umm Ayyub al-Ansariyya informed him, saying:
records.matn_en: The Messenger of God (ﷺ) stayed with us, and we went to trouble to prepare food for him that contained some of these herbs (buqul); he disliked it and said to his companions: “Eat, for I am not like any of you; I dislike to offend my companion.”

continuations.text_en: Al-Humaydi said: Sufyan said: “I saw the Messenger of God (ﷺ) in a dream and said: O Messenger of God, what do you think of this that is narrated from you, that the angels are harmed by what harms the children of Adam? He said: ‘True.’”
continuations.text_ar: قَالَ الْحُمَيْدِيُّ: قَالَ سُفْيَانُ " وَرَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي النَّوْمِ، فَقُلْتُ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَرَأَيْتَ هَذَا الَّذِي يُحَدَّثُ بِهِ عَنْكَ أَنَّ الْمَلَائِكَةَ تَتَأَذَّى مِمَّا يَتَأَذَّى مِنْهُ بَنُو آدَمَ «فَقَالَ» حَقٌّ "

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ قَالَ: ثنا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي يَزِيدَ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ أَبِي يَقُولُ:
records.matn_ar: نَزَلْتُ عَلَى أُمِّ أَيُّوبَ الْأَنْصَارِيَّةِ فَأَخْبَرَتْنِي أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: «نَزَلَ الْقُرْآنُ عَلَى سَبْعَةِ أَحْرُفٍ أَيَّهَا قَرَأْتَ أَصَبْتَ»
records.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying: ʿUbayd Allah ibn Abi Yazid narrated to us, saying: I heard my father say:
records.matn_en: I stayed with Umm Ayyub al-Ansariyya, and she informed me that the Messenger of God (ﷺ) said: “The Qur’an was revealed in seven modes (ahruf); whichever you recite, you are correct.”

groups.title_en: Hadith of Umayma bint Ruqayqa, kinswoman of Khadija, may God be pleased with her
groups.title_ar: حَدِيثُ أُمَيْمَةَ بِنْتِ رَقِيقَةَ نَسِيبَةِ خَدِيجَةَ رضي الله عنها

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ قَالَ: ثنا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُنْكَدِرِ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ أُمَيْمَةَ بِنْتَ رَقِيقَةَ تَقُولُ:
records.matn_ar: بَايَعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي نِسْوَةٍ فَقَالَ: «فِيمَا اسْتَطَعْتُنَّ وَأَطَقْتُنَّ» فَقُلْتُ: اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَرْحَمُ بِنَا مِنْ أَنْفُسِنَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ بَايِعْنَا فَقَالَ «إِنِّي لَا أُصَافِحُكُنَّ إِنَّمَا قَوْلِي لِمِائَةِ امْرَأَةٍ كَقَوْلِي لِامْرَأَةٍ وَاحِدَةٍ» قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ: قِيلَ لِسُفْيَانَ فَإِنَّهُمْ يَقُولُونَ فِيهِ أُمَيْمَةُ بِنْتُ رَقِيقَةَ نَسِيبَةُ خَدِيجَةَ فَقَالَ سُفْيَانُ هِيَ نَسِيبَةُ خَدِيجَةَ وَلَمْ يَقُلْهُ لَنَا ابْنُ الْمُنْكَدِرِ
records.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying: Muhammad ibn al-Munkadir narrated to us, saying: I heard Umayma bint Ruqayqa say:
records.matn_en: I pledged allegiance to the Messenger of God (ﷺ) along with some women, and he said: “Within what you are able and can bear.” I said: God and His Messenger are more merciful to us than we are to ourselves, O Messenger of God; pledge us. He said: “I do not shake hands with you; my word to a hundred women is like my word to a single woman.” Abu Bakr said: It was said to Sufyan: They say in it Umayma bint Ruqayqa, kinswoman of Khadija. Sufyan said: She is the kinswoman of Khadija, but Ibn al-Munkadir did not say it to us.

groups.title_en: Hadith of al-Rubayyiʿ bint Muʿawwidh ibn ʿAfra’, may God be pleased with her
groups.title_ar: حَدِيثُ الرُّبَيِّعِ بِنْتِ مُعَوِّذِ ابْنِ عَفْرَاءَ رضي الله عنها

narrators.ar: عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَقِيلِ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ
narrators.en: ʿAbd Allah ibn Muhammad ibn ʿAqil ibn Abi Talib

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ قَالَ: ثنا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَقِيلِ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: أَرْسَلَنِي عَلِيُّ بْنُ الْحُسَيْنِ إِلَى الرُّبَيِّعِ بِنْتِ مُعَوِّذِ ابْنِ عَفْرَاءَ؛ أَسْأَلُهَا عَنْ وُضُوءِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَكَانَ يَتَوَضَّأُ عِنْدَهَا فَأَتَيْتُهَافَأَخْرَجَتْ إِلِيَّ إِنَاءً يَكُونُ مُدًّا أَوْ مُدَّا وَرُبْعًا بِمُدِّ بَنِي هَاشِمٍ فَقَالَتْ «بِهَذَا كُنْتُ أُخْرِجُ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْوَضُوءَ فَيَبْدَأُ فَيَغْسِلُ يَدَيْهِ ثَلَاثًا قَبْلَ أَنْ يُدْخِلَهُمَا الْإِنَاءَ، ثُمَّ يَتَمَضْمَضُ وَيَسْتَنْثِرُ ثَلَاثًا ثَلَاثًا، وَيَغْسِلُ وَجْهَهُ ثَلَاثًا، ثُمَّ يَغْسِلُ يَدَيْهِ ثَلَاثًا ثَلَاثًا، ثُمَّ يَمْسَحُ بِرَأْسِهِ مُقْبِلًا وَمُدْبِرًا، وَيَغْسِلُ رِجْلَيْهِ ثَلَاثًا ثَلَاثًا» قَالَتْ: وَقَدْ جَاءَنِي ابْنُ عَمَّتِكَ فَسَأَلَنِي عَنْهُ فَأَخْبَرْتُهُ فَقَالَ: مَا عَلِمْنَا فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ إِلَّا غُسْلَيْنِ وَمَسْحَتَيْنِ يَعْنِي ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ: وَوَصَفَ لَنَا سُفْيَانُ الْمَسْحَ فَوَضَعَ يَدَيْهِ عَلَى قَرْنَيْهِ ثُمَّ مَسَحَ بِهِمَا إِلَى جَبْهَتِهِ، ثُمَّ رَفَعَهُمَا وَوَضَعَهُمَا عَلَى قَرْنَيْهِ مِنْ وَسَطِ رَأْسِهِ، ثُمَّ مَسَحَ إِلَى قَفَاهُ قَالَ سُفْيَانُ: وَكَانَ ابْنُ عَجْلَانَ حَدَّثَنَاهُ أَوَّلًا عَنِ ابْنِ عَقِيلٍ، عَنِ الرُّبَيِّعِ فَزَادَ فِي الْمَسْحِ قَالَ: ثُمَّ مَسَحَ مِنْ قَرْنَيْهِ عَلَى عَارِضَيْهِ حَتَّى بَلَغَ طَرَفَ لِحْيَتِهِ، فَلَمَّا سَأَلْنَا ابْنَ عَقِيلٍ عَنْهُ، لَمْ يَصِفْ لَنَا فِي الْمَسْحِ الْعَارِضَيْنِ، وَكَانَ فِي حِفْظِهِ شَيْءٌ فَكَرِهْتُ أَنْ أَلْقَنَهُ
records.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying: ʿAbd Allah ibn Muhammad ibn ʿAqil ibn Abi Talib narrated to us, saying:
records.matn_en: ʿAli ibn al-Husayn sent me to al-Rubayyiʿ bint Muʿawwidh ibn ʿAfra’ to ask her about the ablution of the Messenger of God (ﷺ), who used to perform ablution at her house. I came to her and she brought out to me a vessel holding a mudd, or a mudd and a quarter, by the mudd of Banu Hashim, and said: “With this I used to bring out the ablution water for the Messenger of God (ﷺ); he would begin by washing his hands three times before putting them into the vessel, then he would rinse his mouth and sniff water and blow it out, three times each, and wash his face three times, then wash his arms three times each, then wipe his head, going forward and back, and wash his feet three times each.” She said: Your cousin [son of your paternal aunt] came to me and asked me about it and I told him, and he said: We know in the Book of God only two washings and two wipings — meaning Ibn ʿAbbas. Abu Bakr said: And Sufyan described the wiping for us: he placed his hands on the two sides of his head (qarnayhi), then wiped with them to his forehead, then lifted them and placed them on the two sides of his head from the middle of it, then wiped to his nape. Sufyan said: Ibn ʿAjlan had first narrated it to us from Ibn ʿAqil, from al-Rubayyiʿ, and added in the wiping: He said: “Then he wiped from his two temples (qarnayhi) over his cheeks (ʿaridayhi) until he reached the end of his beard.” When we asked Ibn ʿAqil about it, he did not describe the wiping of the cheeks to us; there was something in his memory, so I disliked to prompt him.

groups.title_en: Hadiths of Umm Qays bint Mihsan al-Asadiyya, of Asad Khuzayma, may God be pleased with her
groups.title_ar: أَحَادِيثُ أُمِّ قَيْسٍ بِنْتِ مُحْصَنٍ الْأَسَدِيَّةِ أَسَدِ خُزَيْمَةَ رضي الله عنها

narrators.ar: عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الزُّهْرِيَّ قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ
records.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أُمَّ قَيْسِ بِنْتَ مُحْصَنٍ الْأَسَدِيَّةَ تَقُولُ: «دَخَلْتُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِابْنٍ لِي لَمْ يَأْكُلِ الطَّعَامَ فَبَالَ عَلَيْهِ فَدَعَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمَاءٍ فَرَشَّهُ عَلَيْهِ»
records.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying: I heard al-Zuhri say: ʿUbayd Allah ibn ʿAbd Allah ibn ʿUtba informed me that he heard Umm Qays bint Mihsan al-Asadiyya say:
records.matn_en: “I came in to the Messenger of God (ﷺ) with a son of mine who had not yet eaten food, and he urinated on him. The Messenger of God (ﷺ) called for water and sprinkled it on it.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الزُّهْرِيَّ قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ
records.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أُمَّ قَيْسٍ بِنْتِ مُحْصَنٍ تَقُولُ: دَخَلْتُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِابْنٍ لِي وَقَدْ أَعْلَقْتُ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ الْعُذْرَةِ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «عَلَى مَا تَدْغُرْنَ أَوْلَادَكُنَّ بِهَذَا الْعَلَاقِ؟ عَلَيْكُمْ بِهَذَا الْعُودِ الْهِنْدِيِّ، فَإِنَّ فِيهِ سَبْعَةَ أَشْفِيَةٍ يُسَعَّطُ مِنَ الْعُذْرَةِ، وَيَلَدُّ مِنْ ذَاتِ الْجَنْبِ» ⦗ص: 339⦘ قَالَ الزُّهْرِيُّ: فَسَّرَ لَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ اثْنَيْنِ وَلَمْ يُفَسِّرْ لَنَا خَمْسَةً قَالَ الْحُمَيْدِيُّ: الْعُودُ الْهِنْدِيُّ هُوَ الْقُسْطُ
records.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying: I heard al-Zuhri say: ʿUbayd Allah ibn ʿAbd Allah informed me that he heard Umm Qays bint Mihsan say:
records.matn_en: I came in to the Messenger of God (ﷺ) with a son of mine for whom I had applied the uvula treatment (aʿlaqtu) for ʿudhra [a throat ailment], and the Messenger of God (ﷺ) said: “For what do you press on your children’s throats with this treatment? Use this Indian wood (al-ʿud al-hindi); in it are seven cures: it is administered through the nose (yusaʿʿatu) for ʿudhra, and through the side of the mouth (yuladdu) for pleurisy (dhat al-janb).” [p. 339] Al-Zuhri said: ʿUbayd Allah explained two of them to us and did not explain five to us. Al-Humaydi said: The Indian wood is al-qust.

groups.title_en: Hadiths of Umm Kurz al-Khuzaʿiyya, may God be pleased with her
groups.title_ar: أَحَادِيثُ أُمِّ كُرْزٍ الْخُزَاعِيَّةِ رضي الله عنها

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي يَزِيدَ قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي أَبِي
records.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ سِبَاعَ بْنَ ثَابِتٍ يُحَدِّثُ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أُمَّ كُرْزٍ الْكَعْبِيَّةَ تَقُولُ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ: «عَنِ الْغُلَامِ شَاتَانِ، وَعَنِ الْجَارِيَةِ شَاةٌ لَا يَضُرُّكُمْ ذُكْرَانًا كُنَّ أَمْ إِنَاثًا»
records.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying: ʿUbayd Allah ibn Abi Yazid narrated to me, saying: My father informed me
records.matn_en: that he heard Sibaʿ ibn Thabit narrating that he heard Umm Kurz al-Kaʿbiyya say: I heard the Messenger of God (ﷺ) say: “For a boy, two sheep; and for a girl, one sheep; it does not matter to you whether they are males or females.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ قَالَ: ثنا عَمْرُو بْنُ دِينَارٍ قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي عَطَاءُ بْنُ أَبِي رَبَاحٍ
records.matn_ar: أَنَّ حَبِيبَةَ بِنْتَ مَيْسَرَةَ الْفِهْرِيَّةِ مَوْلَاتَهُ أَخْبَرَتْهُ أَنَّهَا سَمِعَتْ أُمَّ كُرْزٍ الْخُزَاعِيَّةَ تَقُولُ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ: «فِي الْعَقِيقَةِ عَنِ الْغُلَامِ شَاتَانِ مُكَافَأَتَانِ، وَعَنِ الْجَارِيَةِ شَاةٌ»
records.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying: ʿAmr ibn Dinar narrated to us, saying: ʿAta’ ibn Abi Rabah informed me that Habiba bint Maysara al-Fihriyya, his freedwoman, informed him
records.matn_en: that she heard Umm Kurz al-Khuzaʿiyya say: I heard the Messenger of God (ﷺ) say: “In the ʿaqiqa, for a boy two equivalent sheep (mukafa’atan), and for a girl one sheep.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ قَالَ: ثنا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي يَزِيدَ قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي أَبِي أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ سِبَاعَ بْنَ ثَابِتٍ يَقُولُ: سَمِعْتُ أُمَّ كُرْزٍ الْكَعْبِيَّةَ تَقُولُ:
records.matn_ar: أَتَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِالْحُدَيْبِيَةِ أَطْلُبُ مِنْهُ مِنْ لُحُومِ الْهَدْيِ فَسَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ: «أَقِرُّوا الطَّيْرَ عَلَى مَكِنَاتِهَا»
records.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying: ʿUbayd Allah ibn Abi Yazid narrated to us, saying: My father informed me that he heard Sibaʿ ibn Thabit say: I heard Umm Kurz al-Kaʿbiyya say:
records.matn_en: I came to the Messenger of God (ﷺ) at al-Hudaybiya, asking him for some of the meat of the sacrificial animals, and I heard him say: “Leave the birds on their nesting places (makinat).”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ قَالَ: ثَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي يَزِيدَ قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي أَبِي أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ سِبَاعَ بْنَ ثَابِتٍ يُحَدَّثُ: أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أُمَّ كُرْزٍ تَقُولُ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ:
records.matn_ar: «ذَهَبَتِ النُّبُوَّةُ وَبَقِيَتِ الْمُبَشِّرَاتُ» وَكَانَ سُفْيَانُ يُحَدَّثُ بِهَذَا عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مُرْسَلًا زَمَانًا، ثُمَّ حَدَّثَ بِهِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ سِبَاعٍ، عَنْ أُمَّ كُرْزٍ وَذَكَرَ أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَتْرُكُ إِسْنَادَهَ حَتَّى أَثْبَتَهُ بَعْدُ
records.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying: ʿUbayd Allah ibn Abi Yazid narrated to me, saying: My father informed me that he heard Sibaʿ ibn Thabit narrating that he heard Umm Kurz say: I heard the Messenger of God (ﷺ) say:
records.matn_en: “Prophecy has gone, and glad tidings (mubashshirat) remain.” Sufyan used to narrate this for a time from ʿUbayd Allah, from the Prophet (ﷺ), as a mursal report, and then narrated it from his father, from Sibaʿ, from Umm Kurz; and he mentioned that he used to leave out its isnad until he later established it.

groups.title_en: Hadiths of Umm Haram, may God be pleased with her
groups.title_ar: أَحَادِيثُ أُمِّ حرَامٍ رضي الله عنها

frames_before.title_en: Text before the first numbered narration
frames_before.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الشَّيْخُ الْإِمَامُ الْعَالِمث الزَّاهِدُ الْحَافِظُ تَقِيُّ الدِّينِ أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ عَبْدُ الْغَنِيِّ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْوَاحِدِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ سُرُورٍ الْمَقْدِسِيُّ أَحْسَنَ الَّلُه تَوْفِيقَهُ: ثنا أَبُو الْحَسَنِ سَعْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ نَصْرِ بْنِ الدَّجَّاجِيِّ، وَأَبُو الْمَعَالِى أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْغَنِيِّ ابْنِ حَنِيفَةَ الْبَاجِسْرَائِيُّ بِبَغْدَادَ قَالَا: ثنا أَبُو مَنْصُورٍ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ الْمُقْرِئُ الْمَعْرُوفُ بْالْخَيَّاطِ رحمه الله وَرَضِيَ عَنْهُ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو طَاهِرٍ عَبْدُ الْغَفَّارِ بْنُ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ الْمُؤَدِّبُ قِرَاءَةُ عَلَيْهَ، وَأَنَا أَسْمَعُ فِي سَنَةِ سَبْعٍ وَعِشْرِينَ وَأَرْبَعِمِائَةٍ قَأَقَرَّ بِهِ، قَالَ: ثنا أَبُو عَلِيٍّ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ الصَوَّافُ: ثنا بِشْرٌ قَالَ:
frames_before.en: The Shaykh, the Imam, the scholar, the ascetic, the hafiz Taqi al-Din Abu Muhammad ʿAbd al-Ghani ibn ʿAbd al-Wahid ibn ʿAli ibn Surur al-Maqdisi, may God grant him success, informed us, saying: Abu al-Hasan Saʿd Allah ibn Nasr ibn al-Dajjaji and Abu al-Maʿali Ahmad ibn ʿAbd al-Ghani ibn Hanifa al-Bajisra’i narrated to us in Baghdad; they both said: Abu Mansur Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn ʿAli al-Muqri’, known as al-Khayyat, may God have mercy on him and be pleased with him, narrated to us, saying: Abu Tahir ʿAbd al-Ghaffar ibn Jaʿfar ibn Zayd al-Mu’addib informed us, by reading to him while I listened, in the year 427, and he affirmed it, saying: Abu ʿAli Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn al-Hasan al-Sawwaf narrated to us: Bishr narrated to us, saying:

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا مَرْوَانُ بْنُ مُعَاوِيَةَ قَالَ: ثنا هِلَالُ بْنُ مَيْمُونٍ الْجُهَنِيُّ الرَّمِلِيُّ، عَنْ يَعْلَى بْنِ شَدَّادٍ أَبِي ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ أُمِّ حَرَامٍ قَالَتْ:
records.matn_ar: ذَكَرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم غُزَاةَ الْبَحْرِ لِلْمَائِدِ أَجْرُ شَهِيدٍ، وَلِلْغَرِيقِ أَجْرُ شَهِيدَيْنَ " قَالَتْ: فَقُلْتُ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ادْعُ اللَّهَ عز وجل أَنْ يَجْعَلَنِي مِنْهُمْ، قَالَ «اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْهَا مِنْهُمْ» فَغَزَتِ الْبَحْرَ فَلَمَّا خَرَجَتْ رَكِبَتْ دَابَّتَهَا فَسَقَطَتْ فَمَاتَتْ
records.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Marwan ibn Muʿawiya narrated to us, saying: Hilal ibn Maymun al-Juhani al-Ramli narrated to us, from Yaʿla ibn Shaddad Abu Thabit, from Umm Haram, who said:
records.matn_en: The Messenger of God (ﷺ) mentioned the sea campaigns: “For the one who is dizzy at sea (al-ma’id), the reward of a martyr; and for the drowned, the reward of two martyrs.” She said: I said: O Messenger of God, ask God, Mighty and Majestic, to make me among them. He said: “O God, make her among them.” So she went on a sea campaign, and when she came out she mounted her mount, fell, and died.

groups.title_en: Hadith of Umm Sharik, may God be pleased with her
groups.title_ar: حَدِيثُ أُمِّ شَرِيكٍ رضي الله عنها

narrators.ar: عَبْدُ الْحَمِيدِ بْنُ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ شَيْبَةَ الْحَجَبِيُّ
narrators.en: ʿAbd al-Hamid ibn Jubayr ibn Shayba al-Hajabi

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ قَالَ: ثَنِي عَبْدُ الْحَمِيدِ بْنُ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ شَيْبَةَ الْحَجَبِيُّ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ سَعِيدَ بْنَ الْمُسَيِّبِ يَقُولُ:
records.matn_ar: أَخْبَرَتْنِي أُمُّ شَرِيكٍ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم «أَمَرَهَا بِقَتْلِ الْأَوْزَاغِ»
records.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying: ʿAbd al-Hamid ibn Jubayr ibn Shayba al-Hajabi narrated to me that he heard Saʿid ibn al-Musayyib say:
records.matn_en: Umm Sharik informed me that the Messenger of God (ﷺ) “ordered her to kill geckos (awzagh).”

groups.title_en: Hadith of Baqira, may God be pleased with her
groups.title_ar: حَدِيثُ بَقِيرَةَ رضي الله عنها

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ قَالَ: ثنا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ
records.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ مُحَمَّدَ بْنَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ التَّيْمِيَّ يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ بَقِيرَةَ امْرَأَةِ الْقَعْقَاعِ بْنِ أَبِي حَدْرَدٍ الْأَسْلَمِيِّ قَالَتْ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ يَقُولُ: «يَا هَؤُلَاءِ إِذَا سَمِعْتُمْ بِجَيْشٍ قَدْ خُسِفَ بِهِ قَرِيبًا فَقَدْ أَظَلَّتِ السَّاعَةُ»
records.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying: Muhammad ibn Ishaq narrated to us that he heard Muhammad ibn Ibrahim al-Taymi narrating from Baqira,
records.matn_en: wife of al-Qaʿqaʿ ibn Abi Hadrad al-Aslami, who said: I heard the Messenger of God (ﷺ) on the pulpit say: “O people, when you hear of an army that has been swallowed up by the earth nearby, then the Hour has drawn near.”

groups.title_en: Hadith of Busra bint Safwan, may God be pleased with her
groups.title_ar: حَدِيثُ بُسْرَةَ بِنْتِ صَفْوَانَ رضي الله عنها

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ قَالَ: ثنا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: تَذَاكَرَ أَبِي وَعُرْوَةُ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ مَا يُتَوَضَّأُ مِنْهُ، فَذَكَرَ عُرْوَةُ مَسَّ الذَّكَرِ، فَقَالَ أَبِي: إِنَّ هَذَا لَشَيْءٌ مَا سَمِعْتُ بِهِ قَالَ عُرْوَةُ: بَلَى، أَخْبَرَنِي مَرْوَانُ بْنُ الْحَكَمِ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ بُسْرَةَ بِنْتَ صَفْوَانَ تَقُولُ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «مَنْ مَسَّ ذَكَرَهُ فَلْيَتَوَضَّأْ» فَقُلْتُ لِمَرْوَانَ فَإِنِّي أَشْتَهِي أَنْ تُرْسِلَ إِلَيْهَا، فَأَرْسَلَ إِلَيْهَا، وَأَنَا شَاهِدٌ رَجُلًا، أَوْ قَالَ حَرَسِيٍّ فَجَاءَ الرَّسُولُ مِنْ عِنْدِهَا فَقَالَ: إِنَّهَا قَالَتْ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «مَنْ مَسَّ ذَكَرَهُ فَلْيَتَوَضَّأْ»
records.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying: ʿAbd Allah ibn Abi Bakr narrated to us, saying:
records.matn_en: My father and ʿUrwa ibn al-Zubayr were discussing what requires ablution, and ʿUrwa mentioned touching the penis. My father said: This is something I have never heard of. ʿUrwa said: Yes indeed; Marwan ibn al-Hakam informed me that he heard Busra bint Safwan say: I heard the Messenger of God (ﷺ) say: “Whoever touches his penis, let him perform ablution.” I said to Marwan: I would like you to send to her. So he sent to her — and I was present — a man, or he said a guardsman (harasi), and the messenger came back from her and said: She said: The Messenger of God (ﷺ) said: “Whoever touches his penis, let him perform ablution.”

groups.title_en: Hadith of Khawla bint Qays, wife of Hamza ibn ʿAbd al-Muttalib, may God be pleased with her
groups.title_ar: حَدِيثُ خَوْلَةَ بِنْتِ قَيْسٍ امْرَأَةِ حَمْزَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْمُطَّلِبِ رضي الله عنها

narrators.ar: خَوْلَةَ بِنْتَ قَيْسٍ امْرَأَةَ حَمْزَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْمُطَّلِبِ

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ قَالَ: ثنا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي عُمَرُ بْنُ كَثِيرِ بْنِ أَفْلَحَ، عَنْ عُبَيْدٍ سَنُوطَا قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ خَوْلَةَ بِنْتَ قَيْسٍ امْرَأَةَ حَمْزَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْمُطَّلِبِ تَقُولُ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُذَاكِرُ حَمْزَةَ الدُّنْيَا فَقَالَ:
records.matn_ar: «إِنَّ الدُّنْيَا حُلْوَةٌ خَضِرَةٌ فَإِنْ أَخَذَهَا بِحَقِّهَا بُورِكَ لَهُ فِيهَا، وَرُبَّ مَتَخَوِّضٍ فِي مَالِ اللَّهِ وَمَالِ رَسُولِهِ لَهُ النَّارُ يَوْمَ يَلْقَاهُ» وَرُبَّمَا قَالَ سُفْيَانُ «يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ»
records.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying: Yahya ibn Saʿid narrated to us, saying: ʿUmar ibn Kathir ibn Aflah informed me, from ʿUbayd Sanuta, who said:
records.matn_en: I heard Khawla bint Qays, wife of Hamza ibn ʿAbd al-Muttalib, say: I heard the Messenger of God (ﷺ) discussing the world with Hamza, and he said: “The world is sweet and green; whoever takes it rightfully will be blessed in it, and many a one who plunges into the wealth of God and the wealth of His Messenger — for him is the Fire on the day he meets Him.” And sometimes Sufyan said: “on the Day of Resurrection.”

groups.title_en: Hadith of Kabsha, may God be pleased with her
groups.title_ar: حَدِيثُ كَبْشَةَ رضي الله عنها

narrators.ar: يَزِيدُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ بْنِ جَابِرٍ الْأَزْدِيُّ
narrators.en: Yazid ibn Yazid ibn Jabir al-Azdi

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ قَالَ: ثنا يَزِيدُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ بْنِ جَابِرٍ الْأَزْدِيُّ قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ أَبِي عَمْرَةَ، عَنْ جَدَّتِهِ كَبْشَةَ قَالَتْ:
records.matn_ar: دَخَلَ عَلَيَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ذَاتَ يَوْمٍ «فَشَرِبَ مِنْ فِي قِرْبَةٍ مُعَلَّقَةٍ وَهُوَ قَائِمٌ» قَالَتْ: فَقَطَعْتُ فَمَ الْقِرْبَةِ وَرُبَّمَا قَالَ سُفْيَانُ كَبْشَةُ أَوْ كُبَيْشَةُ وَأَكْثَرُ ذَلِكَ يَقُولُ كُبَيْشَةُ
records.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying: Yazid ibn Yazid ibn Jabir al-Azdi narrated to us, saying: ʿAbd al-Rahman ibn Abi ʿAmra informed me, from his grandmother Kabsha, who said:
records.matn_en: The Messenger of God (ﷺ) came in to me one day “and drank from the mouth of a hanging waterskin while standing.” She said: So I cut off the mouth of the waterskin. And Sufyan sometimes said “Kabsha or Kubaysha,” and most often he said “Kubaysha.”

groups.title_en: Hadith of the paternal aunt of Husayn ibn Mihsan, may God the Exalted have mercy on her
groups.title_ar: حَدِيثُ عَمَّةِ حُصَيْنِ بْنِ مُحْصَنٍ رَحِمَهَا اللَّهُ تَعَالَى

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ قَالَ: ثنا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي بُشَيْرُ بْنُ يَسَارٍ، عَنْ حُصَيْنِ بْنِ مِحْصَنٍ، عَنْ عَمَّةٍ لَهُ قَالَتْ:
records.matn_ar: أَتَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي بَعْضِ الْحَاجَةِ فَقَالَ «يَا هَذِهِ أَذَاتُ بَعْلٍ أَنْتِ؟» قُلْتُ: نَعَمْ قَالَ «فَأَيْنَ أَنْتِ مِنْهُ؟» قَالَتْ: فَقُلْتُ: مَا آلُو إِلَّا مَا عَجَزْتُ عَنْهُ؟ قَالَ «فَأَيْنَ أَنْتِ مِنْهُ؟ فَإِنَّهُ جَنَّتُكِ وَنَارُكِ»
records.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying: Yahya ibn Saʿid narrated to us, saying: Bushayr ibn Yasar informed me, from Husayn ibn Mihsan, from a paternal aunt of his, who said:
records.matn_en: I came to the Messenger of God (ﷺ) about some need, and he said: “O you, do you have a husband?” I said: Yes. He said: “And where are you in relation to him?” She said: I said: I spare no effort except in what I am unable to do. He said: “Look where you stand with him, for he is your Paradise and your Fire.”

groups.title_en: Hadiths of Umm Maʿbad, may God be pleased with her
groups.title_ar: أَحَادِيثُ أُمِّ مَعْبَدٍ رضي الله عنها

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ قَالَ: ثنا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي مَعْبَدُ بْنُ كَعْبٍ، عَنْ أُمِّهِ وَكَانَتْ قَدْ صَلَّتِ الْقِبْلَتَيْنِ قَالَتْ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم «يَنْهَى عَنِ الْخَلِيطَيْنِ التَّمْرِ وَالزَّبِيبِ أَنْ يُنْتَبَذَ» قَالَ
records.matn_ar: «انْتَبِذُوا كُلَّ وَاحِدٍ مِنْهُمَا عَلَى حِدَتِهِ»
records.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying: Muhammad ibn Ishaq narrated to us, saying: Maʿbad ibn Kaʿb informed me, from his mother
records.matn_en: — who had prayed toward both qiblas — who said: I heard the Messenger of God (ﷺ) “forbid the two mixtures (khalitayn), dates and raisins, being steeped together (yuntabadh)”; he said: “Steep each of them on its own.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ قَالَ: ثنا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ مَعْبَدِ بْنِ كَعْبٍ، عَنْ عَمِّهِ أَوْ عَنْ أُمِّهِ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: «تَعَلَّمْنَ يَا هَؤُلَاءِ أَنَّ الْبَذَاذَةَ مِنَ الْإِيمَانِ»
records.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying: Muhammad ibn Ishaq narrated to us, from Maʿbad ibn Kaʿb, from his paternal uncle or from his mother, that
records.matn_en: the Prophet (ﷺ) said: “Learn, O you women, that plainness of dress (badhadha) is part of faith.”

groups.title_en: Hadith of the mother of Sulayman ibn ʿAmr ibn al-Ahwas, may God be pleased with her
groups.title_ar: حَدِيثُ أُمِّ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْأَحْوَصِ رضي الله عنها

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ قَالَ: ثنا يَزِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي زِيَادٍ
records.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنَ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْأَحْوَصِ يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ أُمِّهِ قَالَتْ: رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَرْمِي الْجَمْرَةَ مِنْ بَطْنِ الْوَادِي وَهُوَ عَلَى بَغْلَةٍ وَهُوَ يَقُولُ: «أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ عَلَيْكُمُ السَّكِينَةَ لَا يَقْتُلُ بَعْضُكُمْ بَعْضًا، وَعَلَيْكُمْ مِثْلَ حَصَى الْخَذْفِ»
records.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying: Yazid ibn Abi Ziyad narrated to us that he heard Sulayman ibn ʿAmr ibn al-Ahwas narrating from his mother, who said:
records.matn_en: I saw the Messenger of God (ﷺ) stoning the jamra from the bottom of the valley while he was on a mule, and he was saying: “O people, [keep] tranquility; do not kill one another; and [use] stones like pebbles for throwing (hasa al-khadhf).”

groups.title_en: Hadith of Umm Husayn, may God be pleased with her
groups.title_ar: حَدِيثُ أُمِّ حُصَيْنٍ رضي الله عنها

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ قَالَ: ثنا يُونُسُ بْنُ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ يُحَدِّثُ، عَنِ الْعِيزَارِ بْنِ حُرَيْثٍ، عَنْ أُمِّ الْحُصَيْنِ قَالَتْ:
records.matn_ar: " رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: يَخْطُبُ وَهُوَ مَتَلَفِّعٌ بِبُرْدَةٍ، وَعَضَلَتُهُ تَرْتَجُّ "
records.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying: Yunus ibn Abi Ishaq narrated to us,
records.matn_en: narrating from al-ʿIzar ibn Hurayth, from Umm al-Husayn, who said: “I saw the Messenger of God (ﷺ) giving a sermon, wrapped in a cloak (burda), and the muscle of his arm quivering.”

groups.title_en: Hadiths of Umm ʿAtiyya al-Ansariyya, may God be pleased with her
groups.title_ar: أَحَادِيثُ أُمِّ عَطِيَّةَ الْأَنْصَارِيَّةِ رضي الله عنها

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ قَالَ: ثنا أَيُّوبُ بْنُ أَبِي تَمِيمَةَ السِّخْتِيَانِيُّ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِيرِينَ، عَنْ أُمِّ عَطِيَّةَ قَالَتْ:
records.matn_ar: دَخَلَ عَلَيْنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَنَحْنُ نُغَسِّلُ ابْنَتَهُ فَقَالَ: «اغْسِلْنَهَا ثَلَاثًا أَوْ خَمْسًا، أَوْ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ ذَلِكَ إِنْ رَأَيْتُنَّ ذَلِكَ بِمَاءٍ وَسِدْرٍ وَاجْعَلْنَ فِي الْآخِرَةِ كَافُورًا، أَوْ شَيْئًا مِنْ كَافُورٍ فَإِذَا فَرَغْتُنَّ فَآذِنَّنِي» فَلَمَّا فَرَغْنَا آذَنَّاهُ، فَأَلْقَى إِلَيْنَا حِقْوَهُ فَقَالَ: «أَشْعِرْنَهَا إِيَّاهُ»
records.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying: Ayyub ibn Abi Tamima al-Sikhtiyani narrated to us, from Muhammad ibn Sirin, from Umm ʿAtiyya, who said:
records.matn_en: The Messenger of God (ﷺ) came in to us as we were washing his daughter and said: “Wash her three times, or five, or more than that if you see fit, with water and lote-tree leaves (sidr), and make the last with camphor, or some camphor; and when you have finished, inform me.” When we finished we informed him, and he threw us his waist-wrapper (hiqw) and said: “Wrap her in it (ashʿirnaha iyyahu).”

records.isnad_ar: قَالَ سُفْيَانُ: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَيُّوبُ، عَنْ حَفْصَةَ بِنْتِ سِيرِينَ، عَنْ أُمِّ عَطِيَّةَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِهِ، وَزَادَ فِيهِ قَالَتْ:
records.matn_ar: وَجَعَلْنَا رَأْسَهَا ثَلَاثَةَ قُرُونٍ
records.isnad_en: Sufyan said: And Ayyub also narrated it to us, from Hafsa bint Sirin, from Umm ʿAtiyya, from the Prophet (ﷺ), the like of it, and added in it:
records.matn_en: She said: And we made her hair into three braids.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ قَالَ: ثنا أَيُّوبُ، عَنْ حَفْصَةَ بِنْتِ سِيرِينَ عَنْ امْرَأَةٍ
records.matn_ar: عَنْ أُخْتِهَا وَكَانَ زَوْجُهَا قَدْ غَزَا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِضْعَ عَشْرَةَ غَزْوَةً وَهِيَ مَعَهُ فِي سِتِّ غَزَوَاتٍ مِنْهَا فَقَالَتْ: كُنَّا نُدَاوِي الْكَلْمَى وَنَقُومُ عَلَى الْمَرَضَى، قَالَتْ: فَسَأَلْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم هَلْ عَلَى إِحْدَانَا جُنَاحٌ إِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ لَهَا جِلْبَابٌ أَنْ لَا تَشْهَدَ الْعِيدَ؟ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم «لِتُلْبِسْهَا أُخْتُهَا مِنْ جِلْبَابِهَا، وَتَشْهَدَ الْعِيدَ، وَدَعْوَةَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ»
records.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying: Ayyub narrated to us, from Hafsa bint Sirin, from a woman, from her
records.matn_en: sister — whose husband had campaigned with the Prophet (ﷺ) in twelve-odd (bidʿa ʿashrata) expeditions, she being with him in six of them — who said: We used to treat the wounded and care for the sick. She said: I asked the Messenger of God (ﷺ): Is there any blame on one of us who has no outer cloak (jilbab) if she does not attend the ʿId? The Prophet (ﷺ) said: “Let her sister lend her some of her jilbab, and let her attend the ʿId and the supplication of the Muslims.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ قَالَ: ثنا أَيُّوبُ، عَنْ حَفْصَةَ قَالَتْ:
records.matn_ar: فَسَأَلْنَا أُمَّ عَطِيَّةَ هَلْ سَمِعْتِ هَذَا مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم؟ فَقَالَتْ: نَعَمْ بِأَبَا وَكَانَتْ إِذَا حَدَّثَتْ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَتْ: بِأَبَا سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ: «أَخْرِجُوا الْعَوَاتِقَ، وَذَوَاتِ الْخُدُورِ فَلْيَشْهَدْنَ الْعِيدَ، وَدَعْوَةَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ، وَلْيَعْتَزِلِ الْحُيَّضُ مُصَلَّى الْمُسْلِمِينَ»
records.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying: Ayyub narrated to us, from Hafsa, who said:
records.matn_en: We asked Umm ʿAtiyya: Did you hear this from the Messenger of God (ﷺ)? She said: Yes — bi-aba [“by my father”] — and whenever she narrated from the Messenger of God (ﷺ) she would say: bi-aba — I heard the Messenger of God (ﷺ) say: “Bring out the young women (ʿawatiq) and those who stay in seclusion (dhawat al-khudur), so that they may attend the ʿId and the supplication of the Muslims, and let the menstruating women keep away from the prayer-place of the Muslims.”

groups.title_en: Hadiths of Fatima bint Qays al-Fihriyya, may God be pleased with her
groups.title_ar: أَحَادِيثُ فَاطِمَةَ بِنْتِ قَيْسٍ الْفِهْرِيَّةِ رضي الله عنها

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ قَالَ: ثنا مُجَالِدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الْهَمْدَانِيُّ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: قَدِمَتْ فَاطِمَةُ بِنْتُ قَيْسٍ الْكُوفَةَ عَلَى أَخِيهَا الضَّحَاكِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ وَكَانَ عَامِلًا عَلَيْهَا، فَأَتَيْنَاهَا فَسَأَلْنَاهَا، فَقَالَتْ: كُنْتُ عِنْدَ أَبِي عَمْرِو بْنِ حَفْصِ بْنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ فَطَلَّقَنِي فَبَتَّ طَلَاقِي، وَخَرَجَ إِلَى الْيَمَنِ فَأَتَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَذَكَرْتُ ذَلِكَ لَهُ وَطَلَبْتُ النَّفَقَةَ فَقَالَ بِكُمِّهِ هَكَذَا وَاسْتَتَرَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الْمَرْأَةِ، وَرَفَعَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ كُمَّهُ فَوْقَ رَأْسِهِ، «اسْمَعِي مِنِّي يَا بِنْتَ آلِ قَيْسٍ، إِنَّمَا السُّكْنَى وَالنَّفَقَةُ لِلْمَرْأَةِ إِذَا كَانَ لِزَوْجِهَا عَلَيْهَا رَجْعَةٌ، فَإِذَا لَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ عَلَيْهَا رَجْعَةٌ فَلَا سُكْنَى لَهَا وَلَا نَفَقَةَ» ثُمَّ قَالَ لِي: «اعْتَدِّي عِنْدَ أُمِّ شَرِيكٍ بِنْتِ أَبِي الْعَكَرِ» ثُمَّ قَالَ: «تِلْكَ امْرَأَةٌ يُتَحَدَّثُ عِنْدَهَا، اعْتَدِّي عِنْدَ ابْنِ أُمِّ مَكْتُومٍ فَإِنَّهُ رَجُلٌ مَحْجُوبُ الْبَصَرِ فَتَضَعِينَ ثِيَابَكِ فَلَا يَرَاكِ»
records.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying: Mujalid ibn Saʿid al-Hamdani narrated to us, from al-Shaʿbi, who said:
records.matn_en: Fatima bint Qays came to Kufa to her brother al-Dahhak ibn Qays, who was governor over it; we went to her and asked her. She said: I was with Abu ʿAmr ibn Hafs ibn al-Mughira, and he divorced me irrevocably and went out to Yemen. I came to the Messenger of God (ﷺ), mentioned that to him, and asked for maintenance. He said, with his sleeve, thus — and the Prophet (ﷺ) screened himself from the woman, and Abu Bakr [al-Humaydi] raised his sleeve above his head — “Listen to me, O daughter of the family of Qays: lodging and maintenance are for the woman only when her husband has the right of return (rajʿa) over her; but when he has no right of return over her, she has neither lodging nor maintenance.” Then he said to me: “Observe your waiting period (iʿtaddi) at the house of Umm Sharik bint Abi al-ʿAkar.” Then he said: “That is a woman about whom people converse at her place; observe your waiting period at the house of Ibn Umm Maktum, for he is a blind man, so you may take off your garments and he will not see you.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ قَالَ: ثنا مُجَالِدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: قَدِمَتْ فَاطِمَةُ بِنْتُ قَيْسٍ الْفِهْرِيَّةُ الْكُوفَةَ عَلَى أَخِيهَا الضَّحَّاكِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ وَكَانَ قَدِ اسْتُعْمِلَ عَلَيْهَا فَأَتَيْنَاهَا نَسْأَلُهَا فَقَالَتْ: خَطَبَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي نَحْرِ الظَّهِيرَةِ، فَقَالَ: " إِنِّي لَمْ أَخْطُبْكُمْ لِرَغْبَةٍ وَلَا لِرَهْبَةٍ وَلَكِنْ لِحَدِيثٍ حَدَّثَنِيهِ تَمِيمٌ الدَّارِيُّ مَنَعَنِي سُرُورُهُ الْقَايِلَةَ حَدَّثَنِي تَمِيمٌ الدَّارِيُّ عَنْ بَنِي عَمٍّ لَهُ أَنَّهُمْ أَقْبَلُوا فِي الْبَحْرِ مِنْ نَاحِيَةِ الشَّامِ فَأَصَابَتْهُمْ فِيهِ رِيحٌ عَاصِفٌ فَأَلْجَأَتْهُمْ إِلَى جَزِيرَةٍ فِي الْبَحْرِ فَإِذَا هُمْ فِيهَا بِدَابَّةٍ أَهْدَبَ الْقُبَالِ ? فَقُلْنَا: مَا أَنْتِ يَا دَابَّةُ؟ فَقَالَتْ: أَنَا الْجَسَّاسَةُ فَقُلْنَا: أَخْبِرِينَا، فَقَالَتْ: مَا أَنَا بِمُخْبِرَتِكُمْ وَلَا مُسْتَخْبِرَتِكُمْ شَيْئًا، وَلَكِنْ فِي هَذَا الدَّيْرِ رَجُلٌ بِالْأَشْوَاقِ إِلَى أَنْ يُخْبِرَكُمْ وَتُخْبِرُونَهُ، فَدَخَلْنَا الدَّيْرَ فَإِذَا نَحْنُ بِرَجُلٍ أَعْوَرَ مَوْثُوقٍ بِالسَّلَاسِلِ يُظْهِرُ الْحُزْنَ كَثِيرَ التَّشَكِّي، فَلَمَّا رَآنَا قَالَ: أَفَاتَّبَعْتُمْ، فَأَخْبَرْنَاهُ فَقَالَ: مَا فَعَلَتْ بُحَيْرَةُ الطَّبَرِيَّةِ؟ قُلْنَا عَلَى حَالِهَا تَسْقِي أَهْلَهَا مِنْ مَائِهَا وَتَسْقِي زَرْعَهُمْ ⦗ص: 357⦘ ، قَالَ: فَمَا فَعَلَ نَخْلٌ بَيْنَ عَمَّانَ وَبَيْسَانَ؟ فَقَالُوا: يُطْعِمُ جَنَاهُ كُلَّ عَامٍ، قَالَ: فَمَا فَعَلَتْ عَيْنُ زُغَرَ قَالُوا: يَشْرَبُ مِنْهَا أَهْلُهَا، وَيَسْقُونَ مِنْهَا مَزَارِعَهُمْ قَالَ: فَلَوْ يَبِسَتْ هَذِهِ أَنْفَلِتُ مِنْ وَثَاقِي هَذَا فَلَمْ أَدَعْ بِقَدَمَيَّ هَاتَيْنِ مَنْهَلًا إِلَّا وَطِئْتُهُ إِلَّا الْمَدِينَةَ ثُمَّ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «فَإِلَى هَذَا انْتَهَى سُرُورِي» ثُمَّ قَالَ: «وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ مَا مِنْهَا شُعْبَةٌ إِلَّا وَعَلَيْهَا مَلَكٌ شَاهِرٌ سَيْفَهُ يَرُدُّهُ مِنْ أَنْ يَدْخُلَهَا» قَالَ الشَّعْبِيُّ: فَلَقِيتُ الْمُحَرَّرَ بْنَ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ فَحَدَّثَنِي بِهِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَزَادَ فِيهِ «وَمَكَّةَ» وَقَالَ: مِنْ نَحْوِ الْمَشْرِقِ مَا هُوَ مِنْ نَحْوِ الْمَشْرِقِ مَا هُوَ قَالَ الشَّعْبِيُّ فَلَقِيتُ الْقَاسِمَ بْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ فَحَدَّثَنِي بِهِ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ
records.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying: Mujalid ibn Saʿid narrated to us, from al-Shaʿbi, who said:
records.matn_en: Fatima bint Qays al-Fihriyya came to Kufa to her brother al-Dahhak ibn Qays, who had been appointed over it; we went to her to ask her, and she said: The Messenger of God (ﷺ) addressed us at the height of midday and said: “I have not addressed you out of desire or out of fear, but because of a report that Tamim al-Dari told me, whose joy kept me from the midday nap. Tamim al-Dari told me about some cousins of his, that they were sailing the sea from the direction of Syria when a violent wind struck them and drove them to an island in the sea, and there they found a beast with very thick hair (ahdab al-qubal) [the phrase is followed by a question mark in the printed text]. We said: What are you, O beast? She said: I am al-Jassasa. We said: Tell us. She said: I will neither tell you anything nor ask you anything, but in this monastery there is a man who longs to tell you and be told by you. So we entered the monastery, and there we found a one-eyed man bound in chains, showing grief and complaining much. When he saw us he said: Have you followed? We informed him, and he said: What has happened to Lake Tiberias (Buhayrat al-Tabariyya)? We said: It is as it was, watering its people from its water and watering their crops [p. 357]. He said: And what of the date-palms between ʿAmman and Baysan? They said: They yield their fruit every year. He said: And what of the spring of Zughar? They said: Its people drink from it and water their fields from it. He said: If these were to dry up, I would break free from this bond of mine and would not leave with these two feet of mine a single watering place but I would tread it, except Medina.” Then the Prophet (ﷺ) said: “So to this my joy has come to an end.” Then he said: “By Him in whose hand is my soul, there is no pass of it but that over it is an angel with his sword drawn, turning him back from entering it.” Al-Shaʿbi said: Then I met al-Muharrar ibn Abi Hurayra, who narrated it to me from his father, from the Prophet (ﷺ), and added in it “and Mecca,” and said: “From the direction of the east — mā huwa; from the direction of the east — mā huwa” [an emphatic idiom, as printed]. Al-Shaʿbi said: Then I met al-Qasim ibn Muhammad, who narrated it to me from ʿA’isha, from the Prophet (ﷺ), the like of that.

groups.title_en: Hadiths of Asma bint Yazid ibn Sakan al-Ashhaliyya, may God be pleased with her
groups.title_ar: أَحَادِيثُ أَسْمَاءَ بِنْتِ يَزِيدَ بْنِ سَكَنٍ الْأَشْهَلِيَّةِ رضي الله عنها

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ قَالَ: ثنا ابْنُ أَبِي حُسَيْنٍ، عَنْ شَهْرِ بْنِ حَوْشَبٍ
records.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَسْمَاءَ بِنْتَ يَزِيدَ بْنِ سَكَنٍ تَقُولُ: حَدَّثَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الدَّجَّالِ فَقَرَّبَ أَمْرَهُ، فَقُلْتُ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي لَأَعْجِنُ لِأَهْلِيَ الْعَجِينَ فَمَا أَظُنُّ أَنْ يَبْلُغَ حَتَّى يَخْرُجَ، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «إِنْ يَخْرُجْ وَأَنَا فِيكُمْ فَأَنَا حَجِيجُهُ دُونَكُمْ، وَإِنْ يَخْرُجْ بَعْدِي فَاللَّهُ خَلِيفَتِي عَلَى كُلِّ مُسْلِمٍ»
records.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying: Ibn Abi Husayn narrated to us, from Shahr ibn Hawshab,
records.matn_en: that he heard Asma bint Yazid ibn Sakan say: The Messenger of God (ﷺ) spoke to us about the Dajjal and made his coming seem near. I said: O Messenger of God, I knead the dough for my family, and I do not think it will have risen before he comes out. The Prophet (ﷺ) said: “If he comes out while I am among you, I will be his adversary [in argument] (hajijuhu) on your behalf; and if he comes out after me, then God is my successor over every Muslim.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ قَالَ: ثنا ابْنُ أَبِي حُسَيْنٍ، عَنْ شَهْرِ بْنِ حَوْشَبٍ، عَنْ أَسْمَاءَ بِنْتِ يَزِيدَ بْنِ سَكَنٍ
records.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ سَمِعَهَا تَقُولُ: مَرَّ بِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَنَا فِي نِسْوَةٍ فَسَلَّمَ عَلَيْنَا ثُمَّ قَالَ: «إِيَّاكُنَّ وَكُفْرَ الْمُنْعِمِينَ» قُلْتُ: وَمَا كُفْرُ الْمُنْعِمِينَ؟ قَالَ «لَعَلَّ إِحْدَاكُنَّ أَنْ تَطُولَ أَيْمَتُهَا بَيْنَ أَبَوَيْهَا وَتَعْنِسُ، ثُمَّ يَرْزُقُهَا اللَّهُ ⦗ص: 359⦘ عز وجل زَوْجًا وَيَرْزُقُهَا مِنْهُ مَالًا وَوَلَدًا فَتَغْضَبُ الْغَضْبَةَ فَتَكْفُرَهَا، فَتَقُولُ مَا رَأَيْتُ مِنْكَ مَكَانَ يَوْمٍ بِخَيْرٍ قَطُّ»
records.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying: Ibn Abi Husayn narrated to us, from Shahr ibn Hawshab, from Asma bint Yazid ibn Sakan, that he heard her
records.matn_en: say: The Messenger of God (ﷺ) passed by me while I was among some women and greeted us, then said: “Beware of ingratitude to benefactors (kufr al-munʿimin).” I said: And what is ingratitude to benefactors? He said: “Perhaps one of you remains long unmarried (aymatuha) with her parents and grows old without marrying; then God, Mighty and Majestic [p. 359], provides her a husband and provides her through him wealth and children; then she gets angry one angry moment and denies it all, saying: I have never seen any good from you at any time.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ قَالَ: ثنا ابْنُ أَبِي الْحُسَيْنِ، عَنْ شَهْرِ بْنِ حَوْشَبٍ قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: أَتَيْتُ أَسْمَاءَ بِنْتَ يَزِيدَ فَقَرَّبَتْ إِلِيَّ قِنَاعًا فِيهِ تَمْرٌ أَوْ رُطَبٌ، فَقَالَتْ: كُلْ، فَقُلْتُ: لَا أَشْتَهِيهِ، فَصَاحَتْ بِي كُلْ فَإِنِّي أَنَا الَّتِي قَيَّنْتُ عَائِشَةَ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَتَيْتُهُ بِهَا فَأَجْلَسْتُهَا عَنْ يَمِينِهِ، فَأَتَى النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِإِنَاءٍ فِيهِ لَبَنٌ فَشَرِبَ ثُمَّ نَاوَلَهَا وَطَأْطَأَتْ رَأْسَهَا وَاسْتَحْيَتْ، فَقُلْتُ: خُذِي مِنْ يَدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَخَذَتْ فَشَرِبَتْ ثُمَّ قَالَ لَهَا «نَاوِلِي تِرْبَكِ» فَقُلْتُ: بَلْ أَنْتَ فَاشْرَبْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ثُمَّ نَاوِلْنِي فَشَرِبَ ثُمَّ نَاوَلَنِي، فَأَدَرْتُ الْإِنَاءَ لِأَضَعَ فَمِي عَلَى مَوْضِعِ فِيهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ «أَعْطِي صَوَاحِبَاتِكِ» فَقُلْنَ: لَا نَشْتَهِيهِ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «لَا تَجْمَعْنَ كَذِبًا وَجُوعًا» قَالَتْ: فَأَبْصَرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى إِحْدَاهُنَّ سِوَارًا مِنْ ذَهَبٍ فَقَالَ: «أَتُحِبِّينَ أَنْ يُسْوِرَكِ اللَّهُ عز وجل مَكَانَهُ سِوَارًا مِنْ نَارٍ» قَالَتْ: فَأَعْتَوْنَا عَلَيْهِ حَتَّى نَزَعْنَاهُ فَرَمَيْنَا بِهِ فَمَا نَدْرِي أَيْنَ هُوَ حَتَّى السَّاعَةِ؟ ثُمَّ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «أَمَا يَكْفِي إِحْدَاكُنَّ أَنْ تَتَّخِذَ جُمَانًا مِنْ فِضَّةٍ ثُمَّ تَأْخُذَ شَيْئًا مِنْ زَعْفَرَانَ فَتُدِيفَهُ ثُمَّ تُلَطِّخَهُ عَلَيْهِ فَإِذَا هُوَ كَأَنَّهُ ذَهَبٌ»
records.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying: Ibn Abi al-Husayn narrated to us, from Shahr ibn Hawshab, who said:
records.matn_en: I came to Asma bint Yazid, and she brought near to me a basket (qinaʿ) with dates or fresh dates in it, and said: Eat. I said: I have no appetite for it. She cried out at me: Eat! For I am the one who adorned ʿA’isha for the Messenger of God (ﷺ), and I brought her to him and seated her on his right. A vessel with milk in it was brought to the Prophet (ﷺ); he drank, then handed it to her; she lowered her head and was bashful. I said: Take it from the hand of the Messenger of God (ﷺ). So she took it and drank. Then he said to her: “Hand it to your companion (tirb).” I said: No, you drink, O Messenger of God, then hand it to me. He drank and then handed it to me, and I turned the vessel round to put my mouth on the place where his mouth had been. Then he said: “Give it to your friends.” They said: We do not want it. The Prophet (ﷺ) said: “Do not combine lying with hunger.” She said: Then the Messenger of God (ﷺ) noticed a gold bracelet on one of them and said: “Would you like God, Mighty and Majestic, to put around you in its place a bracelet of fire?” She said: We labored at it (fa-aʿtawna ʿalayhi) [the verb is as printed] until we removed it and threw it away, and to this very hour we do not know where it is. Then the Messenger of God (ﷺ) said: “Is it not enough for one of you to make pearls (jumana) of silver, then take some saffron, dissolve it, and smear it over them, so that they look like gold?”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ قَالَ: ثنا ابْنُ أَبِي الْحُسَيْنِ، عَنْ شَهْرِ بْنِ حَوْشَبٍ
records.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَسْمَاءَ بِنْتَ يَزِيدَ تَقُولُ: بَايَعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي نِسْوَةٍ فَقَالَ: «فِيمَا اسْتَطَعْتُنَّ وَأَطَقْتُنَّ» فَقُلْنَا: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ بَايِعْنَا فَقَالَ: «إِنِّي لَا أُصَافِحُكُنَّ إِنَّمَا آخُذُ عَلَيْكُنَّ مَا أَخَذَ اللَّهُ عز وجل»
records.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying: Ibn Abi al-Husayn narrated to us, from Shahr ibn Hawshab,
records.matn_en: that he heard Asma bint Yazid say: I pledged allegiance to the Messenger of God (ﷺ) along with some women, and he said: “Within what you are able and can bear.” We said: O Messenger of God, pledge us. He said: “I do not shake hands with you; I only take from you what God, Mighty and Majestic, took.”

groups.title_en: Hadith of Muʿadh ibn Jabal, may God be pleased with him
groups.title_ar: حَدِيثُ مُعَاذِ بْنِ جَبَلٍ رضي الله عنه

narrators.ar: مَنْ شَهِدَ مُعَاذَ بْنَ جَبَلٍ حِينَ حَضَرَتْهُ الْوَفَاةُ

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ قَالَ: ثنا عَمْرُو بْنُ دِينَارٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ يَقُولُ: أَخْبَرَنِي مَنْ شَهِدَ مُعَاذَ بْنَ جَبَلٍ حِينَ حَضَرَتْهُ الْوَفَاةُ، يَقُولُ:
records.matn_ar: اكْشِفُوا عَنِّي سَجْفَ الْقُبَّةِ حَتَّى أُحَدِّثَكُمْ حَدِيثًا سَمِعْتُهُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَمْ يَمْنَعْنِي أَنْ أُحَدِّثَكُمْ إِلَّا أَنْ تَتَّكِلُوا عَنِ الْعَمَلِ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ: «مَنْ قَالَ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ مُخْلِصًا مِنْ قَلْبِهِ أَوْ يَقِينًا مْنِ قَلْبِهِ دَخَلَ الْجَنَّةَ، وَلَمْ تَمَسَّهُ النَّارَ»
records.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying: ʿAmr ibn Dinar narrated to us, saying:
records.matn_en: I heard Jabir ibn ʿAbd Allah say: One who was present with Muʿadh ibn Jabal when death came to him informed me, saying: Lift the flap (sajf) of the tent from me so that I may tell you a hadith I heard from the Messenger of God (ﷺ); nothing prevented me from telling you except that you might rely on it and abandon deeds. I heard the Messenger of God (ﷺ) say: “Whoever says ‘There is no god but God,’ sincerely from his heart — or with certainty from his heart — will enter Paradise, and the Fire will not touch him.”

narrators.ar: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الزِّبْرَقَانِ الْأَهْوَازِيُّ أَبُو هَمَّامٍ
narrators.en: Muhammad ibn al-Zibriqan al-Ahwazi Abu Hammam

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الزِّبْرَقَانِ الْأَهْوَازِيُّ أَبُو هَمَّامٍ قَالَ: ثنا يُونُسُ بْنُ عُبَيْدٍ، عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ هِلَالٍ، عَنْ هَصَّانِ بْنِ كَاهِلٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ سَمُرَةَ، عَنْ مُعَاذِ بْنِ جَبَلٍ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: «مَا مِنْ نَفْسٍ تَمُوتُ تَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَأَنِّي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ يَرْجِعُ ذَلِكَ إِلَى قَلْبٍ مُوقِنٍ إِلَّا غَفَرَ اللَّهُ لَهُ»
records.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Muhammad ibn al-Zibriqan al-Ahwazi Abu Hammam narrated to us, saying: Yunus ibn ʿUbayd narrated to us, from Humayd ibn Hilal, from Hassan ibn Kahil, from ʿAbd al-Rahman ibn Samura, from Muʿadh ibn Jabal, that
records.matn_en: the Messenger of God (ﷺ) said: “No soul dies bearing witness that there is no god but God and that I am the Messenger of God, with that returning to a heart that is certain, but that God forgives it.”

groups.title_en: Hadiths of Ubayy ibn Kaʿb, may God be pleased with him
groups.title_ar: أَحَادِيثُ أُبَيِّ بْنِ كَعْبٍ رضي الله عنه

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ قَالَ: ثنا عَمْرُو بْنُ دِينَارٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ جُبَيْرٍ قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: قُلْتُ لِابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ إِنَّ نَوْفًا الْبَكَالِيَّ يَزْعُمُ أَنَّ مُوسَى صَاحِبَ الْخَضِرِ لَيْسَ مُوسَى بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ إِنَّمَا هُوَ مُوسَى آخَرُ فَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ كَذَبَ عَدُوُّ اللَّهِ؛ حَدَّثَنَا أُبَيُّ بْنُ كَعْبٍ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ: " قَامَ مُوسَى خَطِيبًا فِي بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ فَسُئِلَ أَيُّ النَّاسِ أَعْلَمُ؟ فَقَالَ: أَنَا أَعْلَمُ، فَعَتَبَ اللَّهُ عز وجل عَلَيْهِ إِذْ لَمْ يَرُدَّ الْعِلْمَ إِلَيْهِ فَقَالَ: «إِنَّ لِي عَبْدًا بِمَجْمَعِ الْبَحْرَيْنِ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ مِنْكَ» قَالَ مُوسَى أَيْ رَبِّ فَكَيْفَ لِي بِهِ؟ قَالَ: «تَأْخُذُ حُوتًا فَتَجْعَلَهُ فِي مِكْتَلٍ ثُمَّ تَنْطَلِقُ، فَحَيْثُمَا فَقَدْتَ الْحُوتَ فَهُوثَمَّ» فَأَخَذَ حُوتًا فَجَعَلَهُ فِي مِكْتَلٍ ثُمَّ انْطَلَقَ وَانْطَلَقَ مَعَهُ فَتَاهُ يُوشَعُ بْنُ نُونٍ حَتَّى إِذَا انْتَهَى إِلَى الصَّخْرَةِ وَضَعَا رُءُوسَهُمَا فَنَامَا وَاضْطَرَبَ الْحُوتُ فِي الْمِكْتَلِ فَخَرَجَ مِنْهُ فَسَقَطَ فِي الْبَحْرِ {فَاتَّخَذَ سَبِيلَهُ فِي الْبَحْرِ سَرَبًا} [الكهف: 61] وَأَمْسَكَ اللَّهُ عز وجل عَنِ الْحُوتِ جَرْيَةَ الْمَاءِ فَصَارَ عَلَيْهِ مِثْلَ الطَّاقِ، فَلَمَّا اسْتَيْقَظَ مُوسَى نَسِيَ صَاحِبُهُ أَنْ يُخْبِرَهُ بِالْحُوتِ فَانْطَلَقَا بَقِيَّةَ يَوْمِهِمَا وَلَيِلَتِهِمَا حَتَّى إِذَا كَانَ مِنَ الْغَدِ قَالَ مُوسَى لِفَتَاهُ {آتِنَا غَدَاءَنَا لَقَدْ لَقِينَا مِنْ سَفَرِنَا هَذَا نَصَبًا} [الكهف: 62] ⦗ص: 364⦘ قَالَ وَلَمْ يَجِدْ مُوسَى النَّصَبَ حَتَّى جَاوَزَ الْمَكَانَ الَّذِي أَمَرَهُ اللَّهُ عز وجل بِهِ فَقَالَ لَهُ فَتَاهُ {أَرَأَيْتَ إِذْ أَوَيْنَا إِلَى الصَّخْرَةِ فَإِنِّي نَسِيتُ الْحُوتَ وَمَا أَنْسَانِيهُ إِلَّا الشَّيْطَانُ أَنْ أَذْكُرَهُ وَاتَّخَذَ سَبِيلَهُ فِي الْبَحْرِ عَجَبًا} [الكهف: 63] قَالَ وَكَانَ لِلْحُوتِ سَرَبًا وَلِمُوسَى وَفَتَاهُ عَجَبًا فَقَالَ مُوسَى عليه السلام {ذَلِكَ مَا كُنَّا نَبْغِ فَارْتَدَّا عَلَى آثَارِهِمَا قَصَصًا} [الكهف: 64] قَالَ رَجِعَا يَقُصَّانِ آثَارَهُمَا حَتَّى إِذَا انْتَهَيَا إِلَى الصَّخْرَةِ فَإِذَا رَجُلٌ مُسَجًّا ثَوْبًا فَسَلَّمَ عَلَيْهِ مُوسَى فَقَالَ الْخَضِرِ وَأَنَّى بِأَرِضِكَ السَّلَامُ قَالَ أَنَا مُوسَى قَالَ مُوسَى بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ؟ قَالَ: نَعَمْ أَتَيْتُكَ لِتُعَلِّمَنِي مِمَّا عُلِّمْتَ رُشْدًا، قَالَ الْخَضِرِ: إِنَّكَ لَنْ تَسْتَطِيعَ مَعْيَ صَبْرًا يَا مُوسَى إِنِّي عَلَى عِلْمٍ مِنْ عِلْمِ اللَّهِ عز وجل عَلَّمَنِيهِ لَا تَعْلَمُهُ، وَأَنْتَ عَلَى عِلْمٍ مِنْ عِلْمِ اللَّهِ عز وجل عَلَّمَكَهُ اللَّهُ عز وجل لَا أَعْلَمُهُ، فَقَالَ لَهُ مُوسَى {سَتَجِدُنِي إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ صَابِرًا وَلَا أَعْصِي لَكَ أَمْرًا} [الكهف: 69] قَالَ الْخَضِرُ {فَإِنِ اتَّبَعْتَنِي فَلَا تَسْأَلْنِي عَنْ شَيْءٍ حَتَّى أُحْدِثَ لَكَ مِنْهُ ذِكْرًا} [الكهف: 70] فَانْطَلَقَا يَمْشِيَانِ عَلَى سَاحِلِ الْبَحْرِ فَمَرَّتْ بِهِمْ سَفِينَةٌ فَكَلَّمُوهُمْ أَنْ يَحْمِلُوهُمْ فَعَرَفُوا الْخَضِرَ فَحَمَلُوهُمْ بِغَيْرِ نَوْلٍ فَلَمَّا رَكِبَا السَّفِينَةَ لَمْ يُفْجَأْ مُوسَى إِلَّا وَالْخَضِرُ قَدْ قَلَعَ لَوْحًا مِنْ أَلْوَاحِ السَّفِينَةِ بِالْقَدُّومِ فَقَالَ مُوسَى: قَوْمٌ حَمَلُونَا بِغَيْرِ نَوْلٍ عَمَدْتَ إِلَى سَفِينَتِهِمْ فَخَرَقْتَهَا لِتُغَرِقَ أَهْلَهَا {لَقَدْ جِئْتَ شَيْئًا إِمْرًا} [الكهف: 71] قَالَ الْخَضِرُ: {أَلَمْ أَقُلْ إِنَّكَ لَنْ تَسْتَطِيعَ مَعِيَ صَبْرًا} [الكهف: 72] ⦗ص: 365⦘ قَالَ لَهُ مُوسَى {: لَا تُؤَاخِذْنِي بِمَا نَسِيتُ وَلَا تُرْهِقْنِي مِنْ أَمْرِي عُسْرًا} [الكهف: 73] قَالَ: وَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: " وَكَانَتِ الْأُولَى مِنْ مُوسَى نِسْيَانًا، قَالَ: وَجَاءَ عُصْفُورٌ فَوَقَعَ عَلَى حَرْفِ السَّفِينَةِ فَنَقَرَ فِي الْبَحْرِ نَقْرَةً فَقَالَ لَهُ الْخَضِرُ: مَا نَقَصَ عِلْمِي وَعِلْمِكَ مِنْ عِلْمِ اللَّهِ إِلَّا مِثْلُ مَا نَقَصَ الْعُصْفُورُ مِنْ هَذَا الْبَحْرِ ثُمَّ خَرَجَا مِنَ السَّفِينَةِ فَبَيْنَمَا يَمْشِيَانِ عَلَى السَّاحِلِ إِذْ أَبْصَرَ الْخَضِرُ غُلَامًا يَلْعَبُ فِي الْغِلْمَانِ فَأَخَذَ الْخَضِرُ بِرَأْسِهِ فَاقْتَلَعَهُ بِيَدِهِ فَقَتَلَهُ، قَالَ لَهُ مُوسَى: {أَقَتَلْتَ نَفْسًا زَكِيَّةً بِغَيْرِ نَفْسٍ لَقَدْ جِئْتَ شَيْئًا نُكْرًا} [الكهف: 74] {قَالَ أَلَمْ أَقُلْ لَكَ إِنَّكَ لَنْ تَسْتَطِيعَ مَعِيَ صَبْرًا} [الكهف: 75] وَهَذِهِ أَشَدُّ مِنَ الْأُولَى {قَالَ إِنْ سَأَلْتُكَ عَنْ شَيْءٍ بَعْدَهَا فَلَا تُصَاحِبْنِي قَدْ بَلَغْتَ مِنْ لَدُّنِّي عُذْرًا} [الكهف: 76] قَالَ {فَانْطَلَقَا حَتَّى إِذَا أَتَيَا أَهْلَ قَرْيَةٍ اسْتَطْعَمَا أَهْلَهَا فَأَبَوْا أَنْ يُضَيِّفُوهُمَا فَوَجَدَا فِيهَا جِدَارًا يُرِيدُ أَنْ يَنَقَضَّ} [الكهف: 77] قَالَ: مَائِلٌ، فَقَالَ الْخَضِرُ بِيَدِهِ هَكَذَا فَأَقَامَهُ، فَقَالَ مُوسَى قَوْمٌ أَتَيْنَاهُمْ وَلَمْ يُطْعِمُونَا وَلَمْ يُضَيِّفُونَا {لَوْ شِئْتَ لَاتَّخَذْتَ عَلَيْهِ أَجْرًا} [الكهف: 77] {قَالَ: هَذَا فِرَاقُ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنِكَ سَأُنَبِّئُكَ بِتَأْوِيلِ مَا لَمْ تَسْتَطِعْ عَلَيْهِ صَبْرًا} [الكهف: 78] قَالَ: وَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «وَدِدْنَا أَنَّ مُوسَى صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ صَبَرَ حَتَّى يَقُصَّ عَلَيْنَا مِنْ خَبَرِهِمَا» قَالَ سَعِيدُ بْنُ جُبَيْرٍ وَكَانَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ يَقْرَأُ (وَكَانَ أَمَامَهُمْ مَلِكٌ يَأْخُذُ كُلَّ سَفِينَةٍ صَالِحَةٍ غَصْبًا) وَكَانَ يَقْرَأُ (وَأَمَّا الْغُلَامُ فَكَانَ كَافِرًا وَكَانَ أَبَوَاهُ مُؤْمِنَيْنِ)
records.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying: ʿAmr ibn Dinar narrated to us:
records.matn_en: Saʿid ibn Jubayr informed me, saying: I said to Ibn ʿAbbas: Nawf al-Bikali claims that the Musa who was the companion of al-Khidr is not Musa of the Children of Israel, but another Musa. Ibn ʿAbbas said: The enemy of God has lied. Ubayy ibn Kaʿb narrated to us that he heard the Messenger of God (ﷺ) say: “Musa stood up to preach among the Children of Israel, and he was asked: Which of the people is most knowledgeable? He said: I am the most knowledgeable. So God, Mighty and Majestic, rebuked him, because he did not return the knowledge to Him, and said: ‘I have a servant at the junction of the two seas who is more knowledgeable than you.’ Musa said: O my Lord, how can I reach him? He said: ‘Take a fish and put it in a basket (miktal), then set out; wherever you lose the fish, there he will be.’ So he took a fish and put it in a basket, then set out, and his attendant Yushaʿ ibn Nun set out with him, until, when he reached the rock, they laid down their heads and slept. The fish stirred in the basket and came out of it and fell into the sea, ‘and it took its way into the sea in a tunnel’ [Q 18:61]. God, Mighty and Majestic, held back the flow of the water from the fish, so that it became like an arch over it. When Musa woke, his companion forgot to tell him about the fish, and they walked the rest of that day and night, until, when the next morning came, Musa said to his attendant: ‘Bring us our morning meal; we have certainly met in this journey of ours great fatigue’ [Q 18:62]. [p. 364] He said: Musa did not feel fatigue until he had passed the place that God, Mighty and Majestic, had commanded him [to find]. His attendant said to him: ‘Did you see when we took refuge at the rock? Indeed, I forgot the fish — and none made me forget it except Satan — so that I should mention it; and it took its way into the sea in a wondrous manner’ [Q 18:63]. He said: The fish had a tunnel, and for Musa and his attendant it was a wonder. Musa, peace be upon him, said: ‘That is what we were seeking.’ So they returned, following their footprints [Q 18:64]. He said: They went back tracing their footprints until they came to the rock, and there was a man wrapped (musajjan) in a garment. Musa greeted him, and al-Khidr said: And how is there a greeting of peace in your land? He said: I am Musa. He said: Musa of the Children of Israel? He said: Yes. I have come to you so that you may teach me of what you have been taught of right guidance. Al-Khidr said: You will never be able to have patience with me, O Musa. I have knowledge from the knowledge of God, Mighty and Majestic, which He taught me and which you do not know; and you have knowledge from the knowledge of God, Mighty and Majestic, which God taught you and which I do not know. Musa said to him: ‘You will find me, God willing, patient, and I will not disobey you in any order’ [Q 18:69]. Al-Khidr said: ‘Then if you follow me, do not ask me about anything until I myself mention it to you’ [Q 18:70]. So they went walking along the shore of the sea, and a ship passed them; they spoke to the people on it to carry them; they recognized al-Khidr and carried them without fare. When they had boarded the ship, Musa was startled only to see that al-Khidr had pulled out a plank from the planks of the ship with an adze (qaddum). Musa said: A people carried us without fare, and you have gone to their ship and holed it to drown its people? ‘You have certainly done a grave thing’ [Q 18:71]. Al-Khidr said: ‘Did I not say that you would never be able to have patience with me?’ [Q 18:72] [p. 365] Musa said to him: ‘Do not hold me to account for what I forgot, and do not burden me in my affair with difficulty’ [Q 18:73].” He said: And the Messenger of God (ﷺ) said: “The first was from Musa out of forgetfulness.” He said: “And a sparrow came and alighted on the edge of the ship and pecked once in the sea. Al-Khidr said to him: My knowledge and your knowledge have not diminished the knowledge of God except as much as this sparrow has diminished from this sea. Then they left the ship, and while they were walking along the shore, al-Khidr saw a boy playing among the boys; al-Khidr took him by the head, pulled it off with his hand, and killed him. Musa said to him: ‘Have you killed a pure soul for other than a soul? You have certainly done a deplorable thing’ [Q 18:74]. ‘[He] said: Did I not tell you that you would never be able to have patience with me?’ [Q 18:75] — and this was more severe than the first — ‘[Musa] said: If I ask you about anything after this, then do not keep me as a companion; you have obtained from me an excuse’ [Q 18:76]. He said: ‘So they set out, until, when they came to the people of a town, they asked its people for food, but they refused to offer them hospitality; and they found there a wall about to collapse’ [Q 18:77] — he said: leaning — and al-Khidr [gestured] with his hand thus and set it upright. Musa said: A people we came to, and they did not feed us and did not host us — ‘if you wished, you could have taken for it a payment’ [Q 18:77]. ‘[He] said: This is the parting between me and you; I will inform you of the interpretation of that about which you could not have patience’ [Q 18:78].” He said: And the Messenger of God (ﷺ) said: “We wished that Musa, peace be upon him, had been patient, so that He would recount to us more of their story.” Saʿid ibn Jubayr said: And Ibn ʿAbbas used to recite “And ahead of them was a king who seized every sound ship by force,” and he used to recite “And as for the boy, he was a disbeliever, and his parents were believers.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ قَالَ: ثنا مِسْعَرٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ مَيْسَرَةَ الزَّرَّادِ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ فِي قَوْلِهِ عز وجل:
records.matn_ar: {وَكَانَ أَبُوهُمَا صَالِحًا} [الكهف: 82] قَالَ: «حَفِظَهُمَا بِصَلَاحِ أَبِيهِمَا مَا ذَكَرَ مِنْهُمَا صَلَاحًا»
records.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying: Misʿar narrated to us, from ʿAbd al-Malik ibn Maysara al-Zarrad, from Saʿid ibn Jubayr, from Ibn ʿAbbas, concerning the saying
records.matn_en: of God, Mighty and Majestic: “And their father was righteous” [Q 18:82]. He said: “He protected the two of them by the righteousness of their father; no righteousness of the two of them is mentioned.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ قَالَ: ثنا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سُوقَةَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: «إِنَّ اللَّهَ عز وجل لَيَحْفَظُ بِحِفْظِ الرَّجُلِ الصَّالِحِ وَلَدَهُ وَوَلَدَ وَلَدِهِ وَدُوَيْرَتَهُ الَّتِي فِيهَا وَالدُّوَيْرَاتِ حَوْلَهُ فَمَا يَزَالُونَ فِي حِفْظٍ مِنَ اللَّهِ عز وجل» ⦗ص: 367⦘ قَالَ سُفْيَانُ: وَزَادَنِي فِيهِ «وَسِتْرٍ»
records.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying: Muhammad ibn Suqa narrated to us, from Muhammad ibn al-Munkadir, who said:
records.matn_en: “God, Mighty and Majestic, protects, by the protection of a righteous man, his child and his child’s child, and his little house (duwayra) in which he lives and the little houses around it; and they remain in the protection of God, Mighty and Majestic.” [p. 367] Sufyan said: And he added for me in it: “and covering (sitr).”

narrators.ar: عَبْدَةُ بْنُ أَبِي لُبَابَةَ، وَعَاصِمُ ابْنُ بَهْدَلَةَ أَنَّهُمَا
narrators.en: ʿAbda ibn Abi Lubaba and ʿAsim ibn Bahdala

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ قَالَ: ثنا عَبْدَةُ بْنُ أَبِي لُبَابَةَ، وَعَاصِمُ ابْنُ بَهْدَلَةَ أَنَّهُمَا سَمِعَا زِرَّ بْنَ حُبَيْشٍ يَقُولُ:
records.matn_ar: سَأَلْتُ أُبَيَّ بْنَ كَعْبٍ عَنِ الْمُعَوِّذَتَيْنِ فَقُلْتُ: يَا أَبَا الْمُنْذِرِ إِنَّ أَخَاكَ ابْنَ مَسْعُودٍ يَحْكِيهِمَا مِنَ الْمُصْحَفِ قَالَ إِنِّي سَأَلَتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ قِيلَ لِي «قُلْ» فَقُلْتُ: فَنَحْنُ نَقُولُ كَمَا قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ
records.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying: ʿAbda ibn Abi Lubaba and ʿAsim ibn Bahdala narrated to us that they heard Zirr ibn Hubaysh say:
records.matn_en: I asked Ubayy ibn Kaʿb about the two protective suras (al-Muʿawwidhatayn) and said: O Abu al-Mundhir, your brother Ibn Masʿud scrapes them from the mushaf [the printed text reads yahkihima]. He said: I asked the Messenger of God (ﷺ), and he said: “It was said to me: Say.” So I said it. And we say as the Messenger of God (ﷺ) said.

narrators.ar: عَبْدَةُ بْنُ أَبِي لُبَابَةَ، وَعَاصِمُ ابْنُ بَهْدَلَةَ أَنَّهُمَا
narrators.en: ʿAbda ibn Abi Lubaba and ʿAsim ibn Bahdala

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ قَالَ: ثنا عَبْدَةُ بْنُ أَبِي لُبَابَةَ، وَعَاصِمُ ابْنُ بَهْدَلَةَ أَنَّهُمَا سَمِعَا زِرَّ بْنَ حُبَيْشٍ يَقُولُ:
records.matn_ar: قُلْتُ لِأُبَيٍّ إِنَّ أَخَاكَ ابْنَ مَسْعُودٍ يَقُولَ: مَنْ يَقُمِ الْحَوْلَ يُصِبْ لَيْلَةَ الْقَدْرِ فَقَالَ: يَرْحَمُ اللَّهُ أَبَا عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ إِنَّمَا أَرَادَ أَنْ لَا يَتَّكِلَ النَّاسُ، وَلَقَدْ عَلِمَ أَنَّهَا فِي الْعَشْرِ الْأَوَاخِرِ مِنْ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ وَأَنَّهَا لَيْلَةُ سَبْعٍ وَعِشْرِينَ ثُمَّ حَلَفَ أُبَيٌّ لَا يِسْتَثْنِي أَنَّهَا لَلَيْلَةُ سَبْعٍ وَعِشْرِينَ، فَقُلْنَا لَهُ: يَا أَبَا الْمُنْذِرِ بِأَيِّ شَيْءٍ عَلَّمْتَهُ؟ قَالَ: بِالْآيَةِ أَوْ بِالْعَلَامَةِ الَّتِي أَخْبَرَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم «أَخْبَرَنَا أَنَّ الشَّمْسَ تَطْلُعُ صَبِيحَةَ ذَلِكَ الْيَوْمِ وَلَا شُعَاعَ لَهَا»
records.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying: ʿAbda ibn Abi Lubaba and ʿAsim ibn Bahdala narrated to us that they heard Zirr ibn Hubaysh say:
records.matn_en: I said to Ubayy: Your brother Ibn Masʿud says: Whoever stands in prayer through the whole year will catch Laylat al-Qadr. He said: May God have mercy on Abu ʿAbd al-Rahman; he only wanted that people should not rely on it. He well knew that it is in the last ten [nights] of the month of Ramadan and that it is the night of the twenty-seventh. Then Ubayy swore, without making an exception, that it is the night of the twenty-seventh. We said to him: O Abu al-Mundhir, by what do you know it? He said: By the sign — or the portent — that the Messenger of God (ﷺ) told us: “He told us that the sun rises on the morning of that day without rays.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ قَالَ: ثنا عَاصِمٌ الْأَحْوَلُ، عَنْ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ النَّهْدِيِّ، عَنْ أُبَيِّ بْنِ كَعْبٍ قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: كَانَ لِي ابْنُ عَمٍّ شَاسِعُ الدَّارِ فَقُلْتُ: لَوِ اشْتَرَيْتُ بَيْتًا قَرِيبًا مْنَ الْمَسْجِدِ أَوْ حِمَارًا قَالَ: مَا أُحِبُّ أَنَّ بَيْتِيَ مُطْنَبًا بِبَيْتِ مُحَمَّدٍ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَمَا سَمِعْتُ مِنْهُ كَلِمَةً مُنْذُ أَسْلَمَ كَانَتْ أَشَدَّ عَلَيَّ مِنْهَا فَإِذَا هُوَ يَذْكُرُ الْخَطَأَ، فَأَتَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَذَكَرْتُ ذَلِكَ لَهُ فَقَالَ: «إِنَّ لَهُ بِكُلِّ خُطْوَةِ يَخْطُوهَا إِلَى الْمَسْجِدِ دَرَجَةً»
records.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying: ʿAsim al-Ahwal narrated to us, from Abu ʿUthman al-Nahdi, from Ubayy ibn Kaʿb, who said:
records.matn_en: I had a cousin whose house was far away. I said: If only you would buy a house near the mosque, or a donkey! He said: I would not like my house to be adjoining the house of Muhammad (ﷺ). I never heard from him a word since he became Muslim that was harder on me than that — but he was mentioning the steps [the printed text reads al-khata’, “error”]. So I came to the Messenger of God (ﷺ) and told him that, and he said: “For every step he takes toward the mosque he has a degree.”

groups.title_en: Hadiths of Abu Ayyub al-Ansari, may God be pleased with him
groups.title_ar: أَحَادِيثُ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ الْأَنْصَارِيِّ رضي الله عنه

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ قَالَ: ثنا الزُّهْرِيُّ قَالَ: وَأَخْبَرَنِي عَطَاءُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ اللَّيْثِيُّ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا أَيُّوبَ الْأَنْصَارِيَّ يَقُولُ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم:
records.matn_ar: «لَا يَحِلُّ لِمُسْلِمٍ أَنْ يَهْجُرَ أَخَاهُ فَوْقَ ثَلَاثٍ يَلْتَقِيَانِ فَيَصُدُّ هَذَا وَيَصُدُّ هَذَا وَخَيْرُهُمَا الَّذِي يَبْدَأُ بِالسَّلَامِ» قَالَ سُفْيَانُ كَانَ الزُّهْرِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا قَبْلَهُ حَدِيثَ أَنَسٍ ثُمَّ أتْبَعَهُ هَذَا فَقَالَ: وَأَخْبَرَنِي عَطَاءُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ
records.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying: al-Zuhri narrated to us, saying: ʿAta’ ibn Yazid al-Laythi informed me that he heard Abu Ayyub al-Ansari say:
records.matn_en: The Messenger of God (ﷺ) said: “It is not lawful for a Muslim to forsake his brother beyond three [days], the two meeting, and this one turning away and that one turning away; and the better of them is the one who begins with the greeting.” Sufyan said: Al-Zuhri had narrated to us before it the hadith of Anas, then followed it with this and said: And ʿAta’ ibn Yazid informed me.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ قَالَ: ثنا الزُّهْرِيُّ قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي عَطَاءُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ اللَّيْثِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ الْأَنْصَارِيِّ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم:
records.matn_ar: «لَا تَسْتَقْبِلُوا الْقِبْلَةَ بِغَائِطٍ وَلَا بَوْلٍ وَلَا تَسْتَدْبِرُوهَا وَلَكِنْ شَرِّقُوا أَوْ غَرِّبُوا» قَالَ أَبُو أَيُّوبَ فَقَدِمْنَا الشَّامَ فَوَجَدْنَا مَرَاحِيضَ بُنِيَتْ قِبَلَ الْقِبْلَةِ فَنَنْحَرِفُ وَنَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ عز وجل ⦗ص: 370⦘ ، فَقِيلَ لِسُفْيَانَ فَإِنَّ نَافِعَ بْنَ عُمَرَ الْجُمَحِيَّ لَا يُسْنِدُهُ، فَقَالَ: لَكِنِّي أَحْفَظُهُ وَأُسْنِدُهُ كَمَا قُلْتُ لَكَ، ثُمَّ قَالَ: إِنَّ الْمَكِّيِّينَ إِنَّمَا أَخَذُوا كِتَابًا جَاءَ بِهِ حُمَيْدٌ الْأَعْرَجُ مِنَ الشَّامِ قَدْ كُتِبَ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ فَوَقَعَ إِلَى ابْنِ حَرْحَرَةَ وَكَانَ الْمَكِّيُّونَ يَعْرِضُونَ ذَلِكَ الْكِتَابَ عَلَى ابْنِ شِهَابٍ فَأَمَّا نَحْنُ فَإِنَّمَا كُنَّا نَسْمَعُ مِنْ فِيهِ
records.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying: al-Zuhri narrated to us, saying: ʿAta’ ibn Yazid al-Laythi informed me, from Abu Ayyub al-Ansari, who said: The Messenger of God (ﷺ) said:
records.matn_en: “Do not face the qibla when relieving yourselves of stool or urine, and do not turn your backs to it, but face east or west.” Abu Ayyub said: We came to Syria and found latrines that had been built facing the qibla, so we turn aside and seek forgiveness from God, Mighty and Majestic. [p. 370] It was said to Sufyan: Nafiʿ ibn ʿUmar al-Jumahi does not give it a continuous chain. He said: But I memorize it and give it a chain as I told you. Then he said: The Meccans only took a book that Humayd al-Aʿraj brought from Syria, which had been written from al-Zuhri, and it came to Ibn Harhara; and the Meccans used to present that book to Ibn Shihab; as for us, we only used to hear from his mouth.

narrators.ar: إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ حُنَيْنٍ
narrators.en: Ibrahim ibn ʿAbd Allah ibn Hunayn

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ قَالَ: ثنا زَيْدُ بْنُ أَسْلَمَ قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ حُنَيْنٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: امْتَرَأَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ وَالْمِسْوَرُ بْنُ مَخْرَمَةَ بِالْعَرَجِ فِي الْمُحْرِمِ يَغْسِلُ رَأْسَهُ؟ فَأَرْسَلُونِي إِلَى أَبِي أَيُّوبَ الْأَنْصَارِيِّ فَذَهَبْتُ إِلَيْهِ فَوَجَدْتُهُ بَيْنَ قَرْنَيِ الْبِئْرِ يَغْتَسِلُ، فَلَمَّا رَآنِي مُقْبِلًا جَمَعَ ثِيَابَهُ إِلَى صَدْرِهِ حَتَّى نَظَرْتُ إِلَيْهِ فَقُلْتُ: أَرْسَلَنِي إِلَيْكَ ابْنُ أَخِيكَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ أَسْأَلُكَ كَيْفَ رَأَيْتَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَغْسِلُ رَأْسَهُ وَهُوَ مُحْرِمٌ؟ فَقَالَ «بِيَدَيْهِ فِي رَأْسِهِ فَأَقْبَلَ بِهِمَا وَأَدْبَرَ» وَقَالَ: هَكَذَا فَرَجَعْتُ إِلَيْهِمَا فَأَخْبَرْتُهُمَا فَقَالَ الْمِسْوَرُ لِابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ لَا أُمَارِيكَ أَبَدًا
records.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying: Zayd ibn Aslam narrated to us, saying: Ibrahim ibn ʿAbd Allah ibn Hunayn informed me, from his father, who said:
records.matn_en: Ibn ʿAbbas and al-Miswar ibn Makhrama disputed at al-ʿArj about whether a person in ihram may wash his head. They sent me to Abu Ayyub al-Ansari, and I went to him and found him between the two posts of a well, bathing. When he saw me coming he gathered his garments to his chest, until I looked at him. I said: Your nephew Ibn ʿAbbas sent me to you to ask how you saw the Messenger of God (ﷺ) wash his head while in ihram. He said: “With both his hands on his head; he moved them forward and back,” and he said: Like this. I returned to them and told them, and al-Miswar said to Ibn ʿAbbas: I will never dispute with you again.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ قَالَ: ثنا سَعْدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ الْأَنْصَارِيِّ ⦗ص: 371⦘ ، عَنْ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: «مَنْ صَامَ رَمَضَانَ وَأَتْبَعَهُ سِتًّا مِنْ شَوَّالٍ فَكَأَنَّمَا صَامَ الدَّهْرَ» قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ فَقُلْتُ لِسُفْيَانَ أَوْ قِيلَ لَهُ إِنَّهُمْ يَرْفَعُونَهُ قَالَ: اسْكُتْ عَنْهُ قَدْ عَرَفْتُ ذَلِكَ
records.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying: Saʿd ibn Saʿid narrated to us, from ʿUmar ibn Thabit al-Ansari [p.
