records.matn_ar: خَرَجْنَا مَعَ ابْنِ عُمَرَ إِلَى الْحِمَى فَلَمَّا غَرَبَتِ الشَّمْسُ هِبْنَا أَنْ نَقُولَ لَهُ: انْزِلْ فَصَلِ، «فَلَمَّا غَابَ الشَّفَقُ نَزَلَ فَصَلَّى الْمَغْرِبَ بِنَا ثَلَاثًا ثُمَّ سَلَّمَ، وَصَلَّى الْعِشَاءَ رَكْعَتَيْنِ» ثُمَّ الْتَفَتَ إِلَيْنَا، فَقَالَ: «هَكَذَا رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَعَلَ» ⦗ص: 549⦘ ، قَالَ سُفْيَانُ: " وَكَانَ ابْنُ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ كَثِيرًا إِذَا حَدَّثَ بِهَذَا الْحَدِيثِ لَا يَقُولُ فِيهِ: فَلَمَّا غَابَ الشَّفَقُ، يَقُولُ: فَلَمَّا ذَهَبَ بَيَاضُ الْأُفُقِ وَفَحْمَةُ الْعِشَاءِ نَزَلَ فَصَلَّى، فَقُلْتُ لَهُ، فَقَالَ: إِنَّمَا قَالَ إِسْمَاعِيلُ: غَابَ الشَّفَقُ وَلَكِنِّي أَكْرَهُهُ، فَإِذًا أَقُولُ هَكَذَا لِأَنَّ مُجَاهِدًا حَدَّثَنَا أَنَّ الشَّفَقَ النَّهَارُ، قَالَ سُفْيَانُ: فَأَنَا أُحَدِّثُ بِهِ هَكَذَا مَرَّةً، وَهَكَذَا مَرَّةً "
records.isnad_en: Al-Ḥumaydī narrated to us, he said: Sufyān narrated to us, he said: Ibn Abī Najīḥ narrated to us, he said: I heard Ismāʿīl ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Abī Dhuʾayb al-Asadī say:
records.matn_en: We went out with Ibn ʿUmar to al-Ḥimā; when the sun set we hesitated to say to him: Dismount and pray. “When the twilight (shafaq) disappeared he dismounted and led us in the sunset prayer, three rakʿas, then gave the salām, and prayed the night prayer two rakʿas.” Then he turned to us and said: “Thus I saw the Messenger of God ﷺ do.” [p. 549] Sufyān said: “Ibn Abī Najīḥ, when narrating this ḥadīth, would often not say in it ‘when the shafaq disappeared’; he would say: ‘when the whiteness of the horizon and the darkness (faḥma) of the evening had gone, he dismounted and prayed.’ I said to him about it, and he said: Ismāʿīl only said ‘the shafaq disappeared’, but I dislike it; so I say it thus because Mujāhid narrated to us that the shafaq is the daylight.” Sufyān said: “So I narrate it thus sometimes, and thus sometimes.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا ابْنُ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ رَجُلٍ،
records.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَجُلًا سَأَلَ ابْنَ عُمَرَ عَنْ صِيَامِ يَوْمِ عَرَفَةَ، فَقَالَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ: «حَجَجْتُ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلَمْ يَصُمْهُ، وَحَجَجْتُ مَعْ أَبِي بَكْرٍ فَلَمْ يَصُمْهُ، وَحَجَجْتُ مَعَ عُمَرَ فَلَمْ يَصُمْهُ، وَحَجَجْتُ مَعَ عُثْمَانَ فَلَمْ يَصُمْهُ، وَأَنَا لَا أَصُومُهُ وَلَا آمُرُ بِهِ وَلَا أَنْهَى عَنْهُ»
records.isnad_en: Al-Ḥumaydī narrated to us, he said: Ibn Abī Najīḥ narrated to us, from his father, from a man, that
records.matn_en: a man asked Ibn ʿUmar about fasting on the Day of ʿArafa; Ibn ʿUmar said: “I performed ḥajj with the Messenger of God ﷺ and he did not fast it; I performed ḥajj with Abū Bakr and he did not fast it; with ʿUmar and he did not fast it; with ʿUthmān and he did not fast it; and I do not fast it, nor do I order it, nor do I forbid it.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا عَمْرٌو، عَنْ أَبِي الثَّوْرَيْنِ الْجُمَحِيِّ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: سَأَلْتُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ عَنْ صِيَامِ يَوْمِ عَرَفَةَ: «فَنَهَانِي»
records.isnad_en: Al-Ḥumaydī narrated to us, he said: Sufyān narrated to us, he said: ʿAmr narrated to us, from Abū al-Thawrayn al-Jumaḥī, who said:
records.matn_en: I asked Ibn ʿUmar about fasting on the Day of ʿArafa: “and he forbade me.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ أُمَيَّةَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم:
records.matn_ar: «لَا يَحْلِبَنَّ أَحَدٌ مَاشِيَةَ امْرِئٍ بِغَيْرِ إِذْنِهِ ⦗ص: 550⦘ ، أَيُحِبُّ أَحَدُكُمْ أَنْ يُؤْتَى إِلَى بَابِ مَشْرَبَتِهِ فَيُكْسَرُ بَابُهَا، فَيُنْتَثَلُ طَعَامُهُ، أَلَا إِنَّمَا أَطْعِمَتُهُمْ فِي ضُرُوعِ مَواشِيهِمْ»
records.isnad_en: Al-Ḥumaydī narrated to us, he said: Sufyān narrated to us, he said: Ismāʿīl ibn Umayya narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
records.matn_en: “None of you should milk the livestock of another without his permission [p. 550]. Would any of you like his storeroom to be approached, its door broken, and his food scattered? Indeed their foods are in the udders of their livestock.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ أُمَيَّةَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: «سَابَقَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَيْنَ الْخَيْلِ، فَأَرْسَلَ مَا أَضْمَرَ مِنْهَا مِنَ الْحَفْيَاءِ إِلَى مَسْجِدِ بَنِي زُرَيْقٍ، وَأَرْسَلَ مَا لَمْ يَضْمُرْ مِنْهَا مِنْ ثَنِيَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ إِلَى مَسْجِدِ بَنِي زُرَيْقٍ» ⦗ص: 551⦘ قَالَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ: «وَكُنْتُ فِيمَنْ سَابَقَ فَاقْتَحَمَ بِي فَرَسِي فِي حَزَقٍ فَصَرَعَنِي»
records.isnad_en: Al-Ḥumaydī narrated to us, he said: Sufyān narrated to us, he said: Ismāʿīl ibn Umayya narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, who said:
records.matn_en: “The Messenger of God ﷺ held a race between horses; he sent the trained ones from al-Ḥafyāʾ to the mosque of Banū Zurayq, and he sent the untrained ones from Thaniyyat al-Wadāʿ to the mosque of Banū Zurayq.” [p. 551] Ibn ʿUmar said: “And I was among those who raced; my horse plunged with me into a hollow (ḥazaq) and threw me.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُقْبَةَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ:
records.matn_ar: «أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَطَعَ فِي أَمْوَالِ بَنِي النَّضِيرِ وَحَرَقَ» ، قَالَ سُفْيَانُ: «وَلَمْ أَسْمَعْهُ مِنْهُ»
records.isnad_en: Al-Ḥumaydī narrated to us, he said: Sufyān narrated to us, from Mūsā ibn ʿUqba, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar:
records.matn_en: “The Prophet ﷺ cut down and burned the date palms of Banū al-Naḍīr.” Sufyān said: “I did not hear it from him.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ أُمَيَّةَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: أَدْرَكَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عُمَرَ وَهُوَ فِي سَفَرِهِ، وَهُوَ يَقُولُ: وَأَبِي وَأَبِي، فَقَالَ: «أَلَا إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَنْهَاكُمْ أَنْ تَحْلِفُوا بِآبَائِكُمْ، فَمَنْ كَانَ حَالِفًا فَلْيَحْلِفْ بِاللَّهِ أَوْ لِيَصْمُتْ»
records.isnad_en: Al-Ḥumaydī narrated to us, he said: Sufyān narrated to us, he said: Ismāʿīl ibn Umayya narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, who said:
records.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ came upon ʿUmar while he was on his journey, and he was saying: “By my father, by my father!” and he said: “Indeed God forbids you to swear by your fathers; whoever must swear, let him swear by God or remain silent.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا يَزِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي زِيَادٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: بَعَثَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم سَرِيَّةً فَلَقُوا الْعَدُوَّ، فَحَاصَ النَّاسُ حَيْصَةً، فَأَتَيْنَا الْمَدِينَةَ، فَتَخَبَّأْنَا بِهَا، وَقُلْنَا: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، نَحْنُ الْفَرَّارُونَ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «بَلْ أَنْتُمُ الْعَكَّارُونَ وَأنَا فِئَتُكُمْ»
records.isnad_en: Al-Ḥumaydī narrated to us, he said: Sufyān narrated to us, he said: Yazīd ibn Abī Ziyād narrated to us, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Abī Laylā, from Ibn ʿUmar, who said:
records.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ sent out a detachment and they met the enemy, and the people fled in retreat. We came to Medina and hid there, and said: O Messenger of God, we are the deserters. The Messenger of God ﷺ said: “Rather, you are the ones who turn back to fight (al-ʿakkārūn), and I am your refuge.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سُوقَةَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَهُ، يَقُولُ:
records.matn_ar: كَانَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ إِذَا سَمِعَ شَيْئًا لَمْ يَزِدْ فِيهِ وَلَمْ يَنْقُصْ مِنْهُ وَلَمْ يُجَاوِزْهُ إِلَى غَيْرِهِ، وَلَمْ يَقْصُرْ عَنْهُ، فَحَدَّثَ عُبَيْدُ بْنُ عُمَيْرٍ وَابْنُ عُمَرَ جَالِسٌ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: «مَثَلُ الْمُنَافِقِ كَمَثَلِ الشَّاةِ بَيْنَ الْغَنَمَيْنِ تَنْطَحُهَا هَذِهِ مَرَّةً» فَقَالَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ: «بَيْنَ الرَّبْضَيْنِ» ⦗ص: 553⦘ ، فَقِيلَ لَهُ: يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ سَوَاءٌ بَيْنَ الرُّبَيْضَتَيْنِ وَبَيْنَ الْغَنَمَيْنِ، " فَأَبَى ابْنُ عُمَرَ إِلَّا الرَّبْضَيْنِ
records.isnad_en: Al-Ḥumaydī narrated to us, he said: Sufyān narrated to us, he said: Muḥammad ibn Sūqa narrated to us, from Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī, that he heard him
records.matn_en: say: When Ibn ʿUmar heard something he would neither add to it nor subtract from it, nor go beyond it to another, nor fall short of it. ʿUbayd ibn ʿUmayr narrated, while Ibn ʿUmar was sitting, that the Prophet ﷺ said: “The likeness of the hypocrite is like a sheep between two flocks, which one butts at one time [and the other at another].” Ibn ʿUmar said: “Between the two folds (rabḍayn).” [p. 553] It was said to him: O Abū ʿAbd al-Raḥmān, it is the same, between the two little folds and between the two flocks. “But Ibn ʿUmar insisted on ‘the two folds (al-rabḍayn)’.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ السِّخْتِيَانِيُّ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: «نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ بَيْعِ حَبَلِ الْحُبْلَةِ»
records.isnad_en: Al-Ḥumaydī narrated to us, he said: Sufyān narrated to us, he said: Ayyūb al-Sakhtiyānī narrated to us, from Saʿīd ibn Jubayr, from Ibn ʿUmar, who said:
records.matn_en: “The Messenger of God ﷺ forbade the sale of the offspring of the offspring (ḥabal al-ḥabala).”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا أَيُّوبُ السِّخْتِيَانِيُّ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ ⦗ص: 554⦘ ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم:
records.matn_ar: " مَنْ حَلَفَ، فَقَالَ: إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى فَقَدِ اسْتَثْنَى "
records.isnad_en: Al-Ḥumaydī narrated to us, he said: Sufyān narrated to us, he said: Ayyūb al-Sakhtiyānī narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ [p.
records.matn_en: 554], from Ibn ʿUmar, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said: “Whoever swears and says ‘God Almighty willing’ has made an exception.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا أَيُّوبُ السِّخْتِيَانِيُّ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ نَافِعًا، يَقُولُ: سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ، يَقُولُ:
records.matn_ar: كَانَ عَلَى عُمَرَ نَذْرُ اعْتِكَافِ لَيْلَةٍ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ، فَسَأَلَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم «فَأَمَرَهُ أَنْ يَعْتَكِفَ لَيْلَةً وَيَفِيَ بِنَذْرِهِ»
records.isnad_en: Al-Ḥumaydī narrated to us, he said: Sufyān narrated to us, he said: Ayyūb al-Sakhtiyānī narrated to us, he said: I heard Nāfiʿ say: I heard Ibn ʿUmar say:
records.matn_en: ʿUmar had a vow in the Jāhiliyya to perform iʿtikāf for one night in the Sacred Mosque, so he asked the Messenger of God ﷺ, “and he ordered him to perform iʿtikāf for a night and to fulfil his vow.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا أَيُّوبُ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: دَخَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَكَّةَ يَوْمَ الْفَتْحِ عَلَى نَاقَةٍ لِأُسَامَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، حَتَّى أَنَاخَ بِفِنَاءِ الْكَعْبَةِ، ثُمَّ دَعَا عُثْمَانَ بْنَ طَلْحَةَ بِالْمِفْتَاحِ، فَذَهَبَ إِلَى أُمِّهِ، فَأَبَتْ أَنْ تُعْطِيَهُ إِيَّاهُ، فَقَالَ: لَتُعِطِيَنِّي أَوْ لَيَخْرُجَنَّ السَّيْفُ مِنْ صُلْبِي، فَأَعْطَتْهُ الْمِفِتَاحَ، فَفَتَحَ الْبَابَ، فَدَخَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، وَأُسَامَةُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، وَبِلَالٌ، وَعُثْمَانُ بْنُ طَلْحَةَ، وَأَجَافُوا عَلَيْهِمُ الْبَابَ مَلِيًّا، وَكُنْتُ شَابًّا قَوِيًّا فَبَادَرْتُ الْبَابَ حِينَ فُتِحَ، فَاسْتَقْبَلَنِي بِلَالٌ فَقُلْتُ: " يَا بِلَالُ أَيْنَ صَلَّى النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم؟ فَقَالَ: بَيْنَ الْعَمُودَيْنِ الْمُقَدَّمَيْنِ "، وَنَسِيتُ أَنْ أَسْأَلَهُ كَمْ صَلَّى؟
records.isnad_en: Al-Ḥumaydī narrated to us, he said: Sufyān narrated to us, he said: Ayyūb narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, who said:
records.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ entered Mecca on the day of the conquest on a she-camel of Usāma ibn Zayd until he made it kneel in the courtyard of the Kaʿba; then he called ʿUthmān ibn Ṭalḥa for the key, who went to his mother, and she refused to give it to him. He said: You will give it to me, or the sword will come out of my back. So she gave him the key, and he opened the door. The Messenger of God ﷺ entered, with Usāma ibn Zayd, Bilāl and ʿUthmān ibn Ṭalḥa, and they shut the door upon themselves for a good while. I was a strong young man, and I rushed to the door when it was opened; Bilāl met me, and I said: “O Bilāl, where did the Prophet ﷺ pray?” He said: “Between the two front pillars.” And I forgot to ask him how many [rakʿas] he prayed.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا مِسْعَرٌ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ سِمَاكَ الْحَنَفيَّ، يَقُولُ:
records.matn_ar: سَأَلْتُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ، عَنِ الصَّلَاةِ فِي الْبَيْتِ، فَقَالَ: «صَلِّ فِيهِ فَإِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَدْ صَلَّى فِيهِ، وَسَيَأْتِي آخَرُ فَيْنَهَاكَ فَلَا تُطِعْهُ» فَأَتَيْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ فَسَأَلْتُهُ، فَقَالَ: «ائْتَمَّ بِهِ كُلِّهِ، وَلَا تَجْعَلْ مِنْهُ شَيْئًا خَلْفَكَ»
records.isnad_en: Al-Ḥumaydī narrated to us, he said: Sufyān narrated to us, he said: Misʿar narrated to us, he said: I heard Simāk al-Ḥanafī say:
records.matn_en: I asked Ibn ʿUmar about praying inside the House. He said: “Pray in it, for the Messenger of God ﷺ prayed in it; and another will come and forbid you — do not obey him.” Then I went to Ibn ʿAbbās and asked him, and he said: “Take all of it as your direction, and do not put any part of it behind you.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا أَيُّوبُ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: «بَعَثَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم سَرِيَّةً قَبْلَ نَجْدٍ، فَبَلَغَتْ سِهَامُنَا اثْنَا عَشَرَ بَعِيرًا، اثْنَا عَشَرَ بَعِيرًا، وَنَفَلَنَا بَعِيرًا بَعِيرًا»
records.isnad_en: Al-Ḥumaydī narrated to us, he said: Sufyān narrated to us, he said: Ayyūb narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, who said:
records.matn_en: “The Messenger of God ﷺ sent us on a detachment toward Najd, and our shares came to twelve camels each, twelve camels each, and he gave us one extra camel each.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا أَيُّوبُ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: أَصَابَ ابْنَ عُمَرَ بَرْدٌ وَهُوَ مُحْرِمٌ، فَقَالَ لِنَافِعٍ: اطْرَحْ عَلَيَّ شَيْئًا، فَأَلْقَيْتُ عَلَيْهِ بُرْنُسًا فَغَضِبَ، وَقَالَ: «أَطَرَحْتَهُ عَلَيَّ وَقَدْ أَخْبَرْتُكَ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنْهُ» ؟
records.isnad_en: Al-Ḥumaydī narrated to us, he said: Sufyān narrated to us, he said: Ayyūb narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, who said:
records.matn_en: Ibn ʿUmar was struck by cold while in ihrām, and he said to Nāfiʿ: Throw something over me. I threw a burnus over him, and he became angry and said: “Did you throw it over me when I had informed you that the Messenger of God ﷺ forbade it?”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا أَيُّوبُ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ:
records.matn_ar: «أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَجَمَ يَهُودِيَّةً» قَالَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ: «وَلَقَدْ رَأَيْتُهُ يُجَانِئُ عَنْهَا بِيَدِهِ»
records.isnad_en: Al-Ḥumaydī narrated to us, he said: Sufyān narrated to us, he said: Ayyūb narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar:
records.matn_en: “The Messenger of God ﷺ stoned a Jewish woman.” Ibn ʿUmar said: “And I saw him shielding her with his hand (yujāniʾu ʿanhā).”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا أَيُّوبُ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ نَافِعًا، يَقُولُ: سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ، يَقُولُ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم:
records.matn_ar: «مَا حَقُّ امْرِئٍ مُسْلِمٍ لَهُ مَالٌ يُوصَى فِيهِ، ثُمَّ يَأْتِي عَلَيْهِ لَيْلَتَانِ إِلَّا وَوَصِيَّتُهُ مَكْتُوبَةٌ عِنْدَهُ»
records.isnad_en: Al-Ḥumaydī narrated to us, he said: Sufyān narrated to us, he said: Ayyūb narrated to us, he said: I heard Nāfiʿ say: I heard Ibn ʿUmar say:
records.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ said: “It is not right for a Muslim man who has property to bequeath that two nights pass over him without his will written and with him.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، ثنا أَيُّوبُ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم:
records.matn_ar: «إِذَا كَفَّرَ الرَّجُلُ أَخَاهُ فَقَدْ بَاءَ بِهَا أَحَدُهُمَا»
records.isnad_en: Al-Ḥumaydī narrated to us, he said: Sufyān — Ayyūb narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
records.matn_en: “If a man calls his brother an unbeliever, one of them has surely incurred it.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا أَيُّوبُ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم:
records.matn_ar: «لَا يُسَافَرُ بِالْقُرْآنِ إِلَى أَرْضِ الْعَدُوِّ، لَا يَنَالُهُ الْعَدُوُّ»
records.isnad_en: Al-Ḥumaydī narrated to us, he said: Sufyān narrated to us, he said: Ayyūb narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
records.matn_en: “The Qurʾān must not be taken on a journey to the land of the enemy, lest the enemy get hold of it.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا أَيُّوبُ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، أَنَّ ابْنَ عُمَرَ أَقَامَ الصَّلَاةَ بِضُجْنَانَ فِي لَيْلَةٍ مَطِيرَةٍ، ثُمَّ قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: صَلُّوا فِي رِحَالِكُمْ، " كَانَ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَأْمُرُ مُنَادِيَهُ فِي اللَّيْلَةِ الْمَطِيرَةِ، أَوِ اللَّيْلَةِ الْبَارِدَةِ ذَاتِ الرِّيحِ فَيُنَادِي: أَلَّا صَلُّوا فِي رِحَالِكُمْ "
records.isnad_en: Al-Ḥumaydī narrated to us, he said: Sufyān narrated to us, he said: Ayyūb narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, that
records.matn_en: Ibn ʿUmar called the iqāma for the prayer at Ḍajnān on a rainy night, then said: Pray in your lodgings. “The Prophet ﷺ used to order his caller on a rainy night, or a cold, windy night, to call: ‘Pray in your lodgings!’”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا أَيُّوبُ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم:
records.matn_ar: «صَدَقَةُ الْفِطْرِ صَاعٌ مِنْ شَعِيرٍ، أَوْ صَاعٌ مِنْ تَمْرٍ» قَالَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ: «فَلَمَّا كَانَ مُعَاوِيَةُ عَدَلَ النَّاسُ نِصْفَ صَاعٍ بُرٍّ، بِصَاعٍ مِنْ شَعِيرٍ» قَالَ نَافِعٌ وَكَانَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ: «يُخْرِجُ صَدَقَةَ الْفِطْرِ عَنِ الصَّغِيرِ مِنْ أَهْلِهِ وَالْكَبِيرِ، وَالْحُرِّ وَالْعَبْدِ»
records.isnad_en: Al-Ḥumaydī narrated to us, he said: Sufyān narrated to us, he said: Ayyūb narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
records.matn_en: “The zakāt al-fiṭr is a ṣāʿ of barley or a ṣāʿ of dates.” Ibn ʿUmar said: “When Muʿāwiya came, the people made half a ṣāʿ of wheat equal to a ṣāʿ of barley.” Nāfiʿ said: And Ibn ʿUmar “used to give zakāt al-fiṭr for the young and old of his household, the free and the slave.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا عَلِيُّ بْنُ زَيْدِ بْنِ جُدْعَانَ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ الْقَاسِمَ بْنَ رَبِيعَةَ يُخْبِرُ ⦗ص: 560⦘ ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم
records.matn_ar: يَوْمَ فَتْحِ مَكَّةَ عَلَى دَرَجِ الْكَعْبَةِ: «الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي صَدَقَ وَعْدَهُ، وَنَصَرَ عَبْدَهُ، وَهَزَمَ الْأَحْزَابَ وَحْدَهُ، أَلَا إِنَّ قَتِيلَ الْعَمْدِ وَالْخَطَأِ بِالسَّوْطِ أَوِ الْعَصَا فِيهِ مِائَةٌ مِنَ الْإِبِلِ مُغَلَّظَةٌ فِيهَا أَرْبَعُونَ خِلْفَةً فِي بُطُونِهَا أَوْلَادُهَا، أَلَا إِنَّ كُلَّ مَأْثَرَةٍ فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ أَوْ دَمٍ أَوْ مَالٍ، فَهُوَ تَحْتَ قَدَمَيَّ هَاتَيْنِ، إِلَّا مَا كَانَ مِنْ سَدَانَةِ الْبَيْتِ أَوْ سِقَايَةِ الْحَاجِّ، فَإِنِّي قَدْ أَمْضَيْتُهَا لِأَهْلِهَا كَمَا كَانَتْ»
records.isnad_en: Al-Ḥumaydī narrated to us, he said: Sufyān narrated to us, he said: ʿAlī ibn Zayd ibn Judʿān narrated to us
records.matn_en: that he heard al-Qāsim ibn Rabīʿa report [p. 560] from Ibn ʿUmar, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said on the day of the conquest of Mecca, on the steps of the Kaʿba: “Praise be to God, who was true to His promise, helped His servant, and defeated the confederates alone. Indeed, the one killed in a quasi-intentional killing, by whip or staff — for him is a hundred camels, made heavy, among them forty pregnant she-camels with their young in their bellies. Indeed, every claim of distinction in the Jāhiliyya, whether blood or property, is beneath these two feet of mine, except the custody of the House and the watering of the pilgrims, for I have confirmed them for their people as they were.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُعَيْرُ بْنُ الْخِمْسِ التَّمِيمِيُّ، عَنْ حَبِيبِ بْنِ أَبِي ثَابِتٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم:
records.matn_ar: «بُنِيَ الْإِسْلَامُ عَلَى خَمْسٍ، شَهَادَةِ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ، وَإِقَامِ الصَّلَاةِ، وَإِيتَاءِ الزَّكَاةِ، وَصَوْمِ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ، وَحَجَّ الْبَيْتِ» ⦗ص: 561⦘
records.isnad_en: Al-Ḥumaydī narrated to us, he said: Suʿayr ibn al-Khimṣ al-Tamīmī narrated to us, from Ḥabīb ibn Abī Thābit, from Ibn ʿUmar, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
records.matn_en: “Islam is built on five: the testimony that there is no god but God and that Muḥammad is the Messenger of God, establishing the prayer, giving zakāt, fasting the month of Ramadan, and pilgrimage to the House.” [p. 561]

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ مَرَّةً وَاحِدَةً، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ،
records.matn_ar: وَمِسْعَرٍ، ثُمَّ لَمْ أَسْمَعْ سُفْيَانَ يَذْكُرُ مِسْعَرًا بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ
records.isnad_en: Al-Ḥumaydī narrated to us, he said: Sufyān narrated to us,
records.matn_en: once only, from Shuʿba and Misʿar; then I did not hear Sufyān mention Misʿar after that.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا عَمْرُو بْنُ دِينَارٍ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: اشْتَرَى ابْنُ عُمَرَ مِنْ شَرِيكٍ لَنَوَّاسٍ إِبِلًا هِيمًا، فَلَمَّا جَاءَ نَوَّاسٌ، قَالَ لِشَرِيكِهِ: مِمَّنْ بِعْتَهَا، فَوَصَفَ لَهُ صِفَةَ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، فَقَالَ: وَيْحَكَ، ذَلِكَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ، وَأَتَى نَوَّاسٌ إِلَى ابْنِ عُمَرَ، فَقَالَ: أَنَّ شَرِيكِي بَاعَكَ إِبِلًا هِيمًا، وَإِنَّهُ لَمْ يَعْرِفْكَ، قَالَ: خُذْهَا إِذَا، فَلَمَّا ذَهَبَ لِأَخْذِهَا، قَالَ: «دَعْهَا رَضِينَا بِقَضَاءِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَا عَدْوَى» قَالَ سُفْيَانُ: قَالَ عَمْرٌو: وَكَانَ نَوَّاسٌ يُجَالِسُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ، وَكَانَ يُضْحِكُهُ، فَقَالَ يَوْمًا: وَدِدْتُ أَنَّ لِي أَبَا قُبَيْسٍ ذَهَبًا، فَقَالَ لَهُ ابْنُ عُمَرَ: مَا تَصْنَعُ بِهِ؟ قَالَ: «أَمُوتُ عَلَيْهِ» ، فَضَحِكَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ
records.isnad_en: Al-Ḥumaydī narrated to us, he said: Sufyān narrated to us, he said: ʿAmr ibn Dīnār narrated to us, he said:
records.matn_en: Ibn ʿUmar bought from a partner of Nawwās some thirsty camels (hīm). When Nawwās came, he said to his partner: To whom did you sell them? He described Ibn ʿUmar to him, and he said: Woe to you, that is Ibn ʿUmar! Nawwās came to Ibn ʿUmar and said: My partner sold you diseased camels, and he did not recognize you. He said: Then take them back. When he went to take them, he said: “Leave them; we are content with the ruling of the Messenger of God ﷺ: ‘There is no contagion.’” Sufyān said: ʿAmr said: And Nawwās used to sit with Ibn ʿUmar and make him laugh; one day he said: I wish I had Abū Qubays as gold. Ibn ʿUmar said to him: What would you do with it? He said: “I would die upon it.” And Ibn ʿUmar laughed.

narrators.ar: عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ
narrators.en: ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿUmar ibn al-Khaṭṭāb

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا عَمْرٌو، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ، يَقُولُ:
records.matn_ar: لَمَّا حَاصَرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَهْلَ الطَّائِفِ، قَالَ: «إِنَّا قَافِلُونَ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ غَدًا» ، قَالُوا: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ: أَتَقْفِلُ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَفْتَحَهَا؟ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «فَاغْدُوا عَلَى الْقِتَالِ غَدًا إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى» ، قَالَ: فَغَدَوْا عَلَى الْقِتَالِ، فَأَصَابَتْهُمْ جِرَاحَةٌ شَدِيدَةٌ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «إِنَّا قَافِلُونَ غَدًا إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهِ» ، فَكَأَنَّهُمُ اشْتَهَوْا ذَلِكَ وَسَكَنُوا إِلَيْهِ، قَالَ: «فَضَحِكَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم»
records.isnad_en: Al-Ḥumaydī narrated to us, he said: Sufyān narrated to us, he said: ʿAmr narrated to us, he said: I heard ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿUmar ibn al-Khaṭṭāb say:
records.matn_en: When the Messenger of God ﷺ besieged the people of al-Ṭāʾif, he said: “We are returning tomorrow, God willing.” They said: O Messenger of God, will you return before conquering it? The Messenger of God ﷺ said: “Then go out to battle tomorrow, God Almighty willing.” He said: So they went out to battle and suffered severe wounds. The Messenger of God ﷺ said: “We are returning tomorrow, God willing.” It was as if they desired it and were at ease with it. He said: “And the Messenger of God ﷺ laughed.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مَيْسَرَةَ، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: كُنْتُ جَالِسًا عِنْدَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، فَجَاءَ رَجُلٌ، فَقَالَ: " أَنَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ نَبِيذِ الْجَرِّ وَالدُّبَّاءِ؟ فَقَالَ: نَعَمْ "
records.isnad_en: Al-Ḥumaydī narrated to us, he said: Sufyān narrated to us, he said: Ibrāhīm ibn Maysara narrated to us, from Ṭāwūs, who said:
records.matn_en: I was sitting with ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿUmar when a man came and said: “Did the Messenger of God ﷺ forbid the nabīdh of the jarr and of the gourd (dubbāʾ)?” He said: “Yes.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ ⦗ص: 563⦘ ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ فَعَجِلْتُ إِلَيْهِ لِأَسْمَعَ مَا يَقُولُ، فَلَمْ أَنْتَهِ إِلَيْهِ حَتَّى نَزَلَ، فَسَأَلْتُ النَّاسَ أَيَّ شَيْءٍ؟ قَالَ، فَقَالُوا: «نَهَى عَنِ الدُّبَّاءِ وَالْمُزَفَّتِ»
records.isnad_en: Al-Ḥumaydī narrated to us, he said: Sufyān narrated to us, he said: Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ [p.
records.matn_en: 563], from Ibn ʿUmar, who said: I saw the Messenger of God ﷺ on the pulpit and hurried toward him to hear what he was saying, but I had not reached him before he descended. I asked the people: What was it? He said: They said: “He forbade the gourd and the pitch-coated vessel (muzaffat).”

groups.title_en: Reports of Kaʿb ibn ʿUjra (may God be pleased with him)
groups.title_ar: أَحَادِيثُ كَعْبِ بْنِ عُجْرَةَ رضي الله عنه

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا أَيُّوبُ السِّخْتِيَانِيُّ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى، عَنْ كَعْبِ بْنِ عُجْرَةَ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: مَرَّ بِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِالْحُدَيْبِيَةِ وَأَنَا أُوقِدُ تَحْتَ قِدْرٍ أَوْ بُرْمَةٍ، وَالْقُمَّلُ يَتَهَافَتُ مِنْ رَأْسِي، فَقَالَ: «أَيُؤْذِيكَ هَوَامُّكَ يَا كَعْبُ» ، قُلْتُ: نَعَمْ، قَالَ: «فَاحْلِقْ رَأْسَكَ، وَأَنْسِكْ نَسيكَةً، أَوْ صُمْ ثَلَاثَةَ أَيَّامٍ، أَوْ أَطْعِمْ فِرْقًا بَيْنَ سِتَّةِ مَسَاكِينَ»
records.isnad_en: Al-Ḥumaydī narrated to us, he said: Sufyān narrated to us, he said: Ayyūb al-Sakhtiyānī narrated to us, from Mujāhid, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Abī Laylā, from Kaʿb ibn ʿUjra, who said:
records.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ passed by me at al-Ḥudaybiya while I was kindling a fire under a pot, with lice falling from my head. He said: “Are your vermin harming you, Kaʿb?” I said: Yes. He said: “Then shave your head, and offer a sacrifice (nusuk), or fast three days, or feed a faraq among six poor people.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا ابْنُ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى، عَنْ كَعْبِ بْنِ عُجْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، مِثْلَهُ، إِلَّا أَنَّهُ قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: «أَوْقِدْ تَحْتَ قِدْرٍ» ، وَقَالَ: «وَاذْبَحْ شَاةً»
records.isnad_en: Al-Ḥumaydī narrated to us, he said: Sufyān narrated to us, he said: Ibn Abī Najīḥ narrated to us, from Mujāhid, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Abī Laylā, from Kaʿb ibn ʿUjra, from the Prophet ﷺ, the same, except that
records.matn_en: he said: “Kindle a fire under a pot,” and he said: “and slaughter a sheep.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا يَزِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي زِيَادٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى ⦗ص: 565⦘ ، عَنْ كَعْبِ بْنِ عُجْرَةَ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: عَلَّمَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الصَّلَاةَ عَلَيْهِ، فَقَالَ: " قُولُوا: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ، كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ، اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ "
records.isnad_en: Al-Ḥumaydī narrated to us, he said: Sufyān narrated to us, he said: Yazīd ibn Abī Ziyād narrated to us, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Abī Laylā [p.
records.matn_en: 565], from Kaʿb ibn ʿUjra, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ taught us the invocation of blessings upon him, saying: “Say: O God, bless Muḥammad and the family of Muḥammad, as You blessed Ibrāhīm and the family of Ibrāhīm; You are Praiseworthy, Glorious. O God, grant blessing upon Muḥammad and the family of Muḥammad as You granted blessing upon Ibrāhīm and the family of Ibrāhīm; You are Praiseworthy, Glorious.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: وَحَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الْكَرِيمِ أَبُو أُمَيَّةَ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى، عَنْ كَعْبِ بْنِ عُجْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم،
records.matn_ar: بِمِثْلِهِ
records.isnad_en: Al-Ḥumaydī narrated to us, he said: Sufyān narrated to us, he said: ʿAbd al-Karīm Abū Umayya also narrated to me, from Mujāhid, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Abī Laylā, from Kaʿb ibn ʿUjra, from the Prophet ﷺ,
records.matn_en: with the same.

groups.title_en: Reports of ʿAbd Allāh ibn Abī Awfā (may God be pleased with him)
groups.title_ar: أَحَادِيثُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي أَوْفَى رضي الله عنه

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا أَبُو يَعْفُورَ الْعَبْدِيُّ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: أَتَيْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ أَبِي أَوْفَى فَسَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ أَكْلِ الْجَرَادِ، فَقَالَ: «غَزَوْتُ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم سِتَّ غَزَوَاتٍ أَوْ سَبِعَ، فَكُنَّا نَأْكُلُ الْجَرَادَ»
records.isnad_en: Al-Ḥumaydī narrated to us, he said: Sufyān narrated to us, he said: Abū Yaʿfūr al-ʿAbdī narrated to us, he said:
records.matn_en: I came to ʿAbd Allāh ibn Abī Awfā and asked him about eating locusts. He said: “I fought six or seven expeditions with the Messenger of God ﷺ, and we ate locusts.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ الشَّيْبَانِيُّ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ أَوْفَى، يَقُولُ:
records.matn_ar: كُنْتُ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي سَفَرٍ، فَقَالَ لِرَجُلٍ: «انْزِلْ فَاجْدَحْ لِي» ، قَالَ: الشَّمْسُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، قَالَ: «انْزِلْ فَاجْدَحْ لِي» ، قَالَ: الشَّمْسُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، قَالَ: «انْزِلْ فَاجْدَحْ لِي» ، فَنَزَلَ فَجَدَحَ لَهُ، فَشَرِبَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، ثُمَّ رَمَى بِيَدِهِ قِبَلَ الْمَشْرِقِ، فَقَالَ: «إِذَا رَأَيْتُمُ اللَّيْلَ قَدْ أَقْبَلَ مِنْ هَاهُنَا، فَقَدْ أَفْطَرَ الصَّائِمُ»
records.isnad_en: Al-Ḥumaydī narrated to us, he said: Sufyān narrated to us, he said: Abū Isḥāq al-Shaybānī narrated to us, he said: I heard ʿAbd Allāh ibn Abī Awfā say:
records.matn_en: I was with the Prophet ﷺ on a journey, and he said to a man: “Dismount and prepare a drink (ijdaḥ) for me.” He said: The sun, O Messenger of God! He said: “Dismount and prepare it for me.” He said: The sun, O Messenger of God! He said: “Dismount and prepare it for me.” So he dismounted and prepared it for him, and the Prophet ﷺ drank, then threw his hand toward the east and said: “When you see the night advancing from here, the fasting person has broken his fast.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ الشَّيْبَانِيُّ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ أَبِي أَوْفَى، يَقُولُ:
records.matn_ar: «نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الشُّرْبِ فِي الْجَرِّ الْأَخْضَرِ وَالْأَبْيَضِ» ، قَالَ سُفْيَانُ: وَثَالِثًا قَدْ نَسِيتُهُ
records.isnad_en: Al-Ḥumaydī narrated to us, he said: Sufyān narrated to us, he said: Abū Isḥāq al-Shaybānī narrated to us, he said: I heard ʿAbd Allāh ibn Abī Awfā say:
records.matn_en: “The Messenger of God ﷺ forbade drinking from the green and the white jar (jarr).” Sufyān said: “And a third that I have forgotten.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، ثنا أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ الشَّيْبَانِيُّ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ أَبِي أَوْفَى، يَقُولُ:
records.matn_ar: أَصَبْنَا حُمُرًا يَوْمَ خَيْبَرَ خَارِجًا مِنَ الْقَرْيَةِ، فَنَحَرْنَاهَا، فَإِنَّ الْقُدُورَ لَتَغْلَيْ بِهَا، إِذْ نَادَى مُنَادِي النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «أَنْ أَكْفِئُوا الْقُدُورَ بِمَا فِيهَا» ، فَأَكْفَيْنَاهَا، وَإِنَّهَا لَتَفُورُ ⦗ص: 568⦘ قَالَ أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ: فَلَقِيتُ سَعِيدَ بْنَ جُبَيْرٍ، فَذَكَرْتُ ذَلِكَ لَهُ، فَقَالَ: «إِنَّمَا كَانَتْ تِلْكَ حَمِيرًا تَأْكُلُ الْعَذِرَةَ، فَنَهَى النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْهَا»
records.isnad_en: Al-Ḥumaydī narrated to us, he said: Sufyān — Abū Isḥāq al-Shaybānī narrated to us, he said: I heard ʿAbd Allāh ibn Abī Awfā say: We captured donkeys on the day of Khaybar outside the village and slaughtered them, and the pots were boiling with them, when the Prophet’s ﷺ caller called out: “Overturn the pots with what is in them!” So we overturned them, while they were boiling over [p. 568]. Abū Isḥāq said: I met Saʿīd ibn Jubayr and mentioned that to him, and he said: “Those were donkeys that
records.matn_en: ate filth (ʿadhira), and so the Prophet ﷺ forbade them.”

narrators.ar: يَزِيدُ أَبُو خَالِدٍ الدَّالَانِيُّ، وَمِسْعَرُ بْنُ كِدَامٍ
narrators.en: Yazīd Abū Khālid al-Dālānī and Misʿar ibn Kidām

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا يَزِيدُ أَبُو خَالِدٍ الدَّالَانِيُّ، وَمِسْعَرُ بْنُ كِدَامٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ السَّكْسَكِيُّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي أَوْفَى،
records.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَجُلًا، قَالَ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: عَلِّمْنِي يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ شَيْئًا أَقُولُهُ يُجْزِئُنِي مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَلَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ» قَالَ سُفْيَانُ: لَا أَعْلَمُ، إِلَّا أَنَّهُ قَالَ: قَالَ: «وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ»
records.isnad_en: Al-Ḥumaydī narrated to us, he said: Sufyān narrated to us, he said: Yazīd Abū Khālid al-Dālānī and Misʿar ibn Kidām narrated to us, from Ibrāhīm al-Saksakī, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Abī Awfā, that
records.matn_en: a man said to the Prophet ﷺ: Teach me, O Messenger of God, something to say that will suffice me in place of the Qurʾān. The Prophet ﷺ said: “Glory be to God, praise be to God, there is no god but God, and God is greatest.” Sufyān said: I know only that he also said: “and there is no power and no strength except through God.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ الْهَجَرِيًّ،
records.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ رَأَى عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ أَبِي أَوْفَى فِي جِنَازَةِ ابْنَةٍ لَهُ عَلَى بَغْلَةٍ تُقَادُ بِهِ، فَيَقُولُ لِلْقَائِدِ أَيْنَ أَنَا مِنْهَا؟ فَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُ: أَمَامَهَا، قَالَ: أَحْبِسِ، قَالَ: وَرَأَيْتُهُ حِينَ صَلَّى عَلَيْهَا كَبَّرَ أَرْبَعًا، ثُمَّ قَامَ سَاعَةً، فَسَبَّحَ بِهِ الْقَوْمُ فَسَلَّمَ، ثُمَّ قَالَ: أَكُنْتُمْ تَرَوْنَ أَنِّي أَزِيدُ عَلَى أَرْبَعٍ وَقَدْ «رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَبَّرَ أَرْبَعًا، وَسَمِعَ نِسَاءً يَرْثِينَ فَنَهَاهُنَّ» ، وَقَالَ: «سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَنْهَى عَنِ الْمَرَاثِي»
records.isnad_en: Al-Ḥumaydī narrated to us, he said: Sufyān narrated to us, he said: Ibrāhīm ibn Muslim al-Hajarī narrated to us
records.matn_en: that he saw ʿAbd Allāh ibn Abī Awfā at the funeral of a daughter of his, on a mule being led, and he would say to the leader: Where am I in relation to it [the bier]? When he was told: In front of it, he would say: Stop. He said: And I saw him, when he prayed over her, say the takbīr four times, then stand for a while; the people said “subḥān Allāh” to him, so he gave the salām. Then he said: Did you think I would add to four, when “I saw the Messenger of God ﷺ say the takbīr four times, and he heard women lamenting and forbade them,” and he said: “I heard the Messenger of God ﷺ forbid dirges (marāthī).”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ أَبِي خَالِدٍ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ أَبِي أَوْفَى، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَ الْأَحْزَابِ، وَهُوَ يَقُولُ:
records.matn_ar: «اللَّهُمَّ مُنْزِلَ الْكِتَابِ، سَرِيعَ الْحِسَابِ، مُجْرِيَ السَّحَابِ، اهْزِمِ الْأَحْزَابَ، اللَّهُمَّ اهْزِمْهُمْ وَزَلْزِلْهُمْ»
records.isnad_en: Al-Ḥumaydī narrated to us, he said: Sufyān narrated to us, he said: Ismāʿīl ibn Abī Khālid narrated to us, he said:
records.matn_en: I heard ʿAbd Allāh ibn Abī Awfā say: I heard the Messenger of God ﷺ on the day of al-Aḥzāb, saying: “O God, Revealer of the Book, swift in reckoning, Driver of the clouds, defeat the confederates; O God, defeat them and shake them.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا ابْنُ أَبِي خَالِدٍ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: قُلْتُ لِعَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي أَوْفَى: «أَبَشَّرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَدِيجَةَ بِبَيْتٍ فِي الْجَنَّةِ، مِنْ قَصَبٍ، لَا سَخَبَ فِيهِ وَلَا نَصَبَ؟» ، قَالَ: نَعَمْ
records.isnad_en: Al-Ḥumaydī narrated to us, he said: Sufyān narrated to us, he said: Ibn Abī Khālid narrated to us, he said:
records.matn_en: I said to ʿAbd Allāh ibn Abī Awfā: “Did the Messenger of God ﷺ give Khadīja glad tidings of a house in Paradise, made of reed (qaṣab), in which there is no clamor and no toil?” He said: Yes.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ أَبِي خَالِدٍ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ أَبِي أَوْفَى، يَقُولُ:
records.matn_ar: «اعْتَمَرْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَكُنَّا نَسْتُرُهُ حِينَ طَافَ مِنْ صِبْيَانِ أَهْلِ مَكَّةَ لَا يُؤْذُونَهُ» ، قَالَ سُفْيَانُ: «أَرَاهُ فِي عُمْرَةِ الْقَضَاءِ» قَالَ إِسْمَاعِيلُ: «وَأَرَانَا ابْنُ أَبِي أَوْفَى ضَرْبَةً أَصَابَتْهُ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَ حُنَيْنٍ»
records.isnad_en: Al-Ḥumaydī narrated to us, he said: Sufyān narrated to us, he said: Ismāʿīl ibn Abī Khālid narrated to us, he said: I heard ʿAbd Allāh ibn Abī Awfā say:
records.matn_en: “We performed ʿumra with the Messenger of God ﷺ, and we screened him, when he circled, from the children of the people of Mecca, that they not harm him.” Sufyān said: “I think it was in the ʿumrat al-qaḍāʾ.” Ismāʿīl said: “And Ibn Abī Awfā showed us a blow that had struck him with the Prophet ﷺ on the day of Ḥunayn.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا مَالِكُ بْنُ مِغْوَلٍ، عَنْ طَلْحَةَ بْنِ مَصَرِّفٍ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: سَأَلْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ أَبِي أَوْفَى: هَلْ أَوْصَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم؟ فَقَالَ: لَمْ يَتْرُكْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم شَيْئًا يُوصِي فِيهِ، قُلْتُ: وَكَيْفَ أَمَرَ النَّاسَ بِالْوَصِيَّةِ وَلَمْ يُوصِ؟ قَالَ: «أَوْصَى بِكِتَابِ اللَّهِ» ⦗ص: 572⦘ قَالَ طَلْحَةُ: قَالَ الْهُزَيْلُ بْنُ شُرَحْبِيلٍ: أَبُو بَكْرٍ يَتَقَدَّمُ عَلَى وَصَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَدَّ أَبُو بَكْرٍ أَنَّهُ وَجَدَ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ عَهْدًا، فَخَزَمَ بِهِ أَنْفَهُ
records.isnad_en: Al-Ḥumaydī narrated to us, he said: Sufyān narrated to us, he said: Mālik ibn Mighwal narrated to us, from Ṭalḥa ibn Muṣarrif, who said:
records.matn_en: I asked ʿAbd Allāh ibn Abī Awfā: Did the Messenger of God ﷺ make a will? He said: The Messenger of God ﷺ left nothing to bequeath. I said: How, then, did he command the people to make a will when he made none? He said: “He bequeathed [adherence to] the Book of God.” [p. 572] Ṭalḥa said: al-Hudhayl ibn Shuraḥbīl said: Abū Bakr takes precedence over the will of the Messenger of God ﷺ — Abū Bakr wished he had found some covenant from the Messenger of God, so that he could put a nose-bridle on himself with it (fa-khazama bihi anfahu).

groups.title_en: Reports of al-Barāʾ ibn ʿĀzib (may God Almighty be pleased with him)
groups.title_ar: أَحَادِيثُ الْبَرَاءِ بْنِ عَازِبٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى عَنْهُ

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ الْهَمْدَانِيُّ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ الْبَرَاءَ بْنَ عَازِبٍ، يَقُولُ:
records.matn_ar: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، يَقُولُ عِنْدَ مَضْجَعِهِ، أَوْ أَمَرَ أَنْ يُقَالَ عِنْدَ الْمَضْجَعِ، أَوْ أَمَرَنِي أَنْ أَقُولَ عِنْدَ مَضْجَعِي، - شَكَّ فِيهِ سُفْيَانُ لَا يَدْرِي أَيَّتُهُنَّ - قَالَ: «اللَّهُمَّ إِلَيْكَ وَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِي، وَإِلَيْكَ أَسْلَمْتُ نَفْسِي، وَإِلَيْكَ فَوَّضَتُ أَمْرِي، وَإِلَيْكَ أَلْجَأْتُ ظَهْرِي رَغْبَةً، وَرَهْبَةً إِلَيْكَ، لَا مَلْجَأَ وَلَا مَنْجَا مِنْكَ إِلَّا إِلَيْكَ، آمَنْتُ بِكِتَابِكَ الَّذِي أَنْزَلْتَ، وَنَبِيِّكَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلْتَ» ، فَقَالُوا لَهُ: وَبِرَسُولِكَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلْتَ، فَأَبَى، وَقَالَ: «لَا، وَنَبِيِّكَ»
records.isnad_en: Al-Ḥumaydī narrated to us, he said: Sufyān narrated to us, he said: Abū Isḥāq al-Hamdānī narrated to us, he said: I heard al-Barāʾ ibn ʿĀzib say:
records.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ used to say at his bedside, or he ordered that it be said at the bedside, or he ordered me to say at my bedside — Sufyān doubted and did not know which of these — he said: “O God, to You I have turned my face, to You I have submitted myself, to You I have entrusted my affair, to You I have committed my back, in longing and in fear of You; there is no refuge and no escape from You except to You. I believe in Your Book which You have revealed and Your Prophet whom You have sent.” They said to him: “and in Your Messenger whom You have sent,” but he refused and said: “No — ‘and Your Prophet’.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا يَزِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي زِيَادٍ بِمَكَّةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى، عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ بْنِ عَازِبٍ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: «رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا افْتَتَحَ الصَّلَاةَ رَفَعَ يَدَيْهِ» ، قَالَ سُفْيَانُ: " وَقَدِمَ الْكُوفَةَ فَسَمِعْتُهُ يُحَدِّثُ بِهِ، فَزَادَ فِيهِ، ثُمَّ لَا يَعُودُ، فَظَنَنْتُ أَنَّهُمْ لَقَّنُوهُ، وَكَانَ بِمَكَّةَ يَوْمَئذٍ أَحْفَظَ مِنْهُ يَوْمَ رَأَيْتُهُ بِالْكُوفَةِ، وَقَالُوا لِيَ: إِنَّهُ قَدْ تَغَيَّرَ حِفْظُهُ أَوْ سَاءَ حِفْظُهُ "
records.isnad_en: Al-Ḥumaydī narrated to us, he said: Sufyān narrated to us, he said: Yazīd ibn Abī Ziyād narrated to us
records.matn_en: in Mecca, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Abī Laylā, from al-Barāʾ ibn ʿĀzib, who said: “I saw the Messenger of God ﷺ, when he began the prayer, raise his hands.” Sufyān said: “He came to Kufa and I heard him narrate it; he added to it, and then did not repeat it. I thought they had prompted him. In Mecca on that day he was a better memorizer than on the day I saw him in Kufa, and they said to me: His memory has changed, or his memory has become poor.”

narrators.en: Abān ibn Taghlib — and he was eloquent

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا أَبَانُ بْنُ تَغْلِبَ، وَكَانَ فَصِيحًا، عَنِ الْحَكَمِ بْنِ عُتَيْبَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى، عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ بْنِ عَازِبٍ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: «لَمْ يَكُنْ مِنَّا أَحَدٌ يَحْنُو حَتَّى يَرَى رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَدْ خَرَّ سَاجِدًا»
records.isnad_en: Al-Ḥumaydī narrated to us, he said: Sufyān narrated to us, he said: Abān ibn Taghlib — and he was eloquent — narrated to us, from al-Ḥakam ibn ʿUtayba, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Abī Laylā, from al-Barāʾ ibn ʿĀzib, who said:
records.matn_en: “None of us would bend down until he saw that the Messenger of God ﷺ had fallen in prostration.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ،
records.matn_ar: وَمِسْعَرُ بْنُ كِدَامٍ، أَنَّهُمَا سَمِعَا عَدِيَّ بْنَ ثَابِتٍ يُحَدِّثُ، عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ، قَالَ: " سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُوَ يَقْرَأُ فِي الْمَغْرِبِ بِالتِّينِ وَالزَّيْتُونِ. قَالَ سُفْيَانُ: زَادَ مِسْعَرٌ: فَمَا سَمِعْتُ إِنْسَانًا أَحْسَنَ قِرَاءَةً مِنْهُ "
records.isnad_en: Al-Ḥumaydī narrated to us, he said: Sufyān narrated to us, he said: Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd and Misʿar ibn Kidām narrated to us, that both heard ʿAdī ibn Thābit narrate from al-Barāʾ, who said:
records.matn_en: “I heard the Messenger of God ﷺ reciting in the sunset prayer {By the fig and the olive}.” Sufyān said: Misʿar added: “I never heard anyone with a more beautiful recitation than he.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا عَمْرُو بْنُ دِينَارٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا الْمِنْهَالِ، يَقُولُ:
records.matn_ar: بَاعَ شَرِيكٌ لِيَ بِالْكُوفَةِ دَرَاهِمَ بِدَرَاهِمَ بَيْنَهُمَا فَضْلٌ، فَقُلْتُ: مَا أَرَى هَذَا يَصْلُحُ، فَقَالَ: لَقَدْ بِعْتُهَا فِي السُّوقِ فَمَا عَابَ ذَلِكَ عَلَيَّ أَحَدٌ، فَأَتَيْتُ الْبَرَاءَ بْنَ عَازِبٍ فَسَأَلْتُهُ، قَالَ: قَدِمَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْمَدِينَةَ وَتِجَارَتُنَا هَكَذَا، فَقَالَ: «مَا كَانَ يَدًا بِيَدٍ فَلَا بَأْسَ بِهِ، وَمَا كَانَ نَسِيئَةً فَلَا خَيْرَ فِيهِ» وَأْتِ ابْنَ أَرْقَمَ، فَإِنَّهُ كَانَ أَعْظَمَ تِجَارَةً مِنِّي، فَأَتَيْتُهُ ⦗ص: 575⦘ فَذَكَرْتُ ذَلِكَ لَهُ، فَقَالَ: صَدَقَ الْبَرَاءُ، قَالَ الْحُمَيْدِيُّ: «هَذَا مَنْسُوخٌ وَلَا يُؤْخَذُ بِهِ»
records.isnad_en: Al-Ḥumaydī narrated to us, he said: Sufyān narrated to us, he said: ʿAmr ibn Dīnār narrated to us that he heard Abū al-Minhāl say:
records.matn_en: A partner of mine in Kufa sold dirhams for dirhams with a surplus between them. I said: I do not think this is permissible. He said: I sold them in the market and no one faulted me for it. So I went to al-Barāʾ ibn ʿĀzib and asked him, and he said: The Prophet ﷺ came to Medina when our trade was like this, and he said: “What is hand to hand, there is no harm in it; and what is on credit, there is no good in it.” And go to Ibn Arqam, for his trade was greater than mine. So I went to him [p. 575] and mentioned that to him, and he said: Al-Barāʾ has spoken truly. Al-Ḥumaydī said: “This is abrogated and is not to be acted upon.”

groups.title_en: Reports of Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī (may God be pleased with him)
groups.title_ar: أَحَادِيثُ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ رضي الله عنه

frames_before.title_en: Text before the first numbered narration
frames_before.ar: حَدَّثَنَا الشَّيْخُ الْإِمَامُ الزَّاهِدُ الْعَالِمُ الْحَافِظُ تَقِىُّ الدِّينِ أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ عَبْدُ الْغَنِيِّ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْوَاحِدِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ سُرُورٍ الْمَقْدِسِيُّ أَحْسَنَ اللَّهُ تَوْفِيقَهُ، قَالَ: ثنا الْفَقِيهُ أَبُو الْحَسَنِ سَعْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ نَصْرٍ الدَّجَاجِيُّ الْوَاعِظُ، وَأَبُو المْعََالِي أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْغَنِيِّ بْنِ حَنِيفَةَ الْبَاجِسْرِائِيُّ قَالَا: ثنا الْإِمَامُ أَبُو مَنْصُورٍ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ الْمُقْرِئُ الْمَعْرُوفُ بِالْخَيَّاطِ قَالَ: ثنا أَبُو طَاهِرٍ عَبْدُ الْغَفَّارِ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ الْمُؤَدِّبُ قِرَاءَةُ عَلَيْهِ وَأَنَا أَسْمَعُ فِي سَنَةِ سَبْعٍ وَعِشْرِينَ وَأَرْبَعِمِائَةٍ فَأَقَرَّ بِهِ، قَالَ: ثنا أَبُو عَلِيٍّ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ الصَوَّافِ قِرَاءَةُ عَلَيْهِ وَأَنَا أَسْمَعُ قاَلَ: ثنا أَبُو عَلِيٍّ بِشْرُ بْنُ مُوسَى قَالَ:
frames_before.en: The Shaykh, the Imām, the ascetic, the scholar, the ḥāfiẓ Taqī al-Dīn Abū Muḥammad ʿAbd al-Ghanī ibn ʿAbd al-Wāḥid ibn ʿAlī ibn Surūr al-Maqdisī — may God grant him success — narrated to us, he said: The jurist Abū al-Ḥasan Saʿd Allāh ibn Naṣr al-Dajājī the preacher, and Abū al-Maʿālī Aḥmad ibn ʿAbd al-Ghanī ibn Ḥanīfa al-Bājisrāʾī narrated to us, both said: The Imām Abū Manṣūr Muḥammad ibn Aḥmad ibn ʿAlī al-Muqriʾ, known as al-Khayyāṭ, narrated to us, he said: Abū Ṭāhir ʿAbd al-Ghaffār ibn Jaʿfar al-Muʾaddib narrated to us, [the text] being read to him while I listened, in the year 427, and he acknowledged it, he said: Abū ʿAlī Muḥammad ibn Aḥmad ibn al-Ḥasan ibn al-Ṣawwāf narrated to us, [the text] being read to him while I listened, he said: Abū ʿAlī Bishr ibn Mūsā narrated to us, he said:

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا الزُّهْرِيُّ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي حُمَيْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، "
records.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَأَى نُخَامَةً فِي قِبْلَةِ الْمَسْجِدِ، فَأَخَذَ حَصَاةً فَحَكَّهَا، وَنَهَى أَنْ يَبْزُقَ الرَّجُلُ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ، أَوْ عَنْ يَمِينِهِ، وَقَالَ: لِيَبْزُقْ عَنْ يَسَارِهِ، أَوْ تَحْتَ قَدَمِهِ الْيُسْرَى "
records.isnad_en: Al-Ḥumaydī narrated to us, he said: Sufyān narrated to us, he said: al-Zuhrī narrated to us, he said: Ḥumayd ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān informed me, from Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī, “that
records.matn_en: the Messenger of God ﷺ saw phlegm on the qibla wall of the mosque, took a pebble and scraped it off, and forbade a man to spit in front of him or to his right, and said: ‘Let him spit to his left, or beneath his left foot.’”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَجْلَانَ،
records.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ عِيَاضَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي سَرْحٍ ⦗ص: 4⦘ ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيَّ، يَقُولُ: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُعْجِبُهُ هَذِهِ الْعَرَاجِينَ، يُمْسِكُهَا فِي يَدِهِ، وَيَدْخُلُ الْمَسْجِدَ وَهِيَ فِي يَدِهِ، فَرَأَى نُخَامَةً فِي قِبْلَةِ الْمَسْجِدِ، فَحَكَّهَا، ثُمَّ أَقْبَلَ عَلَى النَّاسِ مُغْضَبًا، فَقَالَ: «أَيُحِبُّ أَحَدُكُمْ أَنْ يُبْزَقَ فِي وَجْهِهِ» ، ثُمَّ قَالَ: «إِنَّ الْعَبْدَ إِذَا قَامَ إِلَى الصَّلَاةِ فَإِنَّمَا يُوَاجِهُ رَبَّهُ، فَلَا يَبْزُقْ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ، وَلَا عَنْ يَمِينِهِ، وَلْيَبْزُقْ عَنْ يَسَارِهِ، أَوْ تَحْتَ قَدَمِهِ الْيُسْرَى، فَإِنْ عَجَّلَتْ بِهِ بَادِرَةٌ وَهُوَ يُصَلِّي، فَلْيَتْفُلْ فِي ثَوْبِهِ، وَلَيْقُلْ هَكَذَا» ، وَدَلَّكَ سُفْيَانُ بِكُمِّهِ
records.isnad_en: Al-Ḥumaydī narrated to us, he said: Sufyān narrated to us, he said: Muḥammad ibn ʿAjlān narrated to us
records.matn_en: that he heard ʿIyāḍ ibn ʿAbd Allāh ibn Saʿd ibn Abī Sarḥ [p. 4] — that he heard Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī say: The Messenger of God ﷺ liked these palm-stalks (ʿarājīn), holding one in his hand and entering the mosque with it in his hand. He saw phlegm on the qibla wall of the mosque and scraped it off, then turned to the people, angry, and said: “Would any of you like to be spat in the face?” Then he said: “When a servant stands to pray, he is facing his Lord; so let him not spit in front of him, nor to his right, but let him spit to his left or beneath his left foot. And if an urge overcomes him while he is praying, let him spit into his garment, and say thus” — and Sufyān rubbed with his sleeve.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا الزُّهْرِيُّ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي عَطَاءُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ اللَّيْثِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: " نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ بَيْعَتَيْنِ، وَعَنْ لُبْسَتَيْنِ، فَأَمَّا الْبَيْعَتَانِ: فَالْمُلَامَسَةُ، وَالْمُنَابَذَةُ، وَأَمَّا اللُّبْسَتَانِ: فَاشْتِمَالُ الصَّمَّاءِ، وَاحْتِبَاءُ الرُّجُلِ فِي الثَّوْبِ الْوَاحِدِ لَيْسَ عَلَى فَرْجِهِ مِنْهُ شَيْءٌ "
records.isnad_en: Al-Ḥumaydī narrated to us, he said: Sufyān narrated to us, he said: al-Zuhrī narrated to us, he said: ʿAṭāʾ ibn Yazīd al-Laythī informed me, from Abū Saʿīd, who said:
records.matn_en: “The Messenger of God ﷺ forbade two kinds of sale and two kinds of dress. As for the two sales: al-mulāmasa and al-munābadha; and as for the two dresses: ishtimāl al-ṣammāʾ, and a man’s sitting wrapped in a single garment (iḥtibāʾ) with nothing of it over his private part.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا ضَمْرَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الْمَازِنِيُّ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيَّ، يَقُولُ:
records.matn_ar: «نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ صَلَاةٍ بَعْدَ صَلَاةِ الْعَصْرِ حَتَّى تَغْرُبَ الشَّمْسَ، وَعَنْ صَلَاةٍ بَعْدَ صَلَاةِ الصُّبْحِ حَتَّى تَطْلُعَ الشَّمْسُ»
records.isnad_en: Al-Ḥumaydī narrated to us, he said: Sufyān narrated to us, he said: Ḍamra ibn Saʿīd al-Māzinī narrated to us, he said: I heard Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī say:
records.matn_en: “The Messenger of God ﷺ forbade prayer after the ʿaṣr prayer until the sun sets, and prayer after the dawn prayer until the sun rises.”

narrators.ar: عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي صَعْصَعَةَ
narrators.en: ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Abī Ṣaʿṣaʿa
my father — and he was an orphan in the care of Abū Saʿīd

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي صَعْصَعَةَ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ أَبِي وَكَانَ يَتِيمًا فِي حِجْرِ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: قَالَ لِي أَبُو سَعِيدٍ: أَيْ بُنَيَّ، إِذَا كُنْتَ فِي هَذِهِ الْبَوادِي فَارْفَعْ صَوْتَكَ بِالْأَذَانِ ⦗ص: 6⦘ ، فَإِنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، يَقُولُ: «لَا يَسْمَعُهُ إِنْسٌ، وَلَا جِنٌّ، وَلَا حَجَرٌ، وَلَا شَجَرٌ، وَلَا شَيْءٌ إِلَّا شَهِدَ لَهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ»
records.isnad_en: Al-Ḥumaydī narrated to us, he said: Sufyān narrated to us, he said: ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Abī Ṣaʿṣaʿa narrated to us, he said: I heard my father — and he was an orphan in the care of Abū Saʿīd — say:
records.matn_en: Abū Saʿīd said to me: My son, when you are in these deserts, raise your voice with the adhān [p. 6], for I heard the Messenger of God ﷺ say: “No human, no jinn, no stone, no tree and nothing hears it but will testify for him on the Day of Resurrection.”

narrators.ar: عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي صَعْصَعَةَ
narrators.en: ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Abī Ṣaʿṣaʿa

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي صَعْصَعَةَ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَاهُ، يَقُولُ: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيَّ، يَقُولُ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم:
records.matn_ar: «يُوشِكُ أَنْ يَكُونَ خَيْرَ مَالِ الرَّجُلِ الْمُسْلِمِ غَنَمٌ يَتْبَعُ شَعَفَ الْجِبَالِ، وَمَواقِعَ الْقَطْرِ، يَفِرُّ بِدِينِهِ مِنَ الْفِتَنِ»
records.isnad_en: Al-Ḥumaydī narrated to us, he said: Sufyān narrated to us, he said: ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Abī Ṣaʿṣaʿa narrated to us that he heard his father say: I heard Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī say:
records.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ said: “A time is about to come when the best property of a Muslim man will be sheep which he follows to mountain peaks and rain-fall places, fleeing with his religion from trials.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا يَزِيدُ بْنُ خُصَيْفَةَ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ بُسْرَ بْنَ سَعِيدٍ، يَقُولُ: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيُّ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: إِنِّي لَفِي حَلَقَةٍ فِيهَا أُبَيُّ بْنُ كَعْبٍ جَالِسًا، إِذْ جَاءَنَا أَبُو مُوسَى الْأَشْعَرِيُّ مَذْعُورًا، أَوْ قَالَ: فَزِعًا، فَقُلْنَا: مَا شَأْنُكَ؟ قَالَ: إِنَّ عُمَرَ بَعَثَ إِلَيَّ فِي بَعْضِ الْحَاجَةِ فَأَتَيْتُهُ، فَاسْتَأْذَنْتُ ثَلَاثًا فَلَمْ يُؤْذَنْ لِي فَرَجَعْتُ، وَقُلْتُ لَهُ: إِنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، يَقُولُ: «إِذَا اسْتَأْذَنَ أَحَدُكُمْ ثَلَاثًا فَلَمْ يُؤْذَنْ لَهُ فَلْيَرْجِعْ» ، فَقَالَ عُمَرُ: لَتَأْتِيَنَّ عَلَى مَا قُلْتَ بِبَيِّنَةٍ، أَوْ لَأَفْعَلَنَّ بِكَ، وَلَأَفْعَلَنَّ، فَقَالَ لِي أَبَيُّ بْنُ كَعْبٍ: لَا يَقُومُ مَعَكَ إِلَّا أَصْغَرُ الْقَوْمِ، قَالَ سَعِيدٌ: فَكُنْتُ أَنَا أَصْغَرَ الْقَوْمِ، فَأَتَيْتُ عُمَرَ، فَحَدَّثْتُهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، قَالَ: «إِذَا اسْتَأْذَنَ أَحَدُكُمْ ثَلَاثًا فَلَمْ يُؤْذَنْ لَهُ فَلْيَرْجِعْ»
records.isnad_en: Al-Ḥumaydī narrated to us, he said: Sufyān narrated to us, he said: Yazīd ibn Khuṣayfa narrated to us, he said:
records.matn_en: I heard Busr ibn Saʿīd say: Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī narrated to me, he said: I was in a circle in which Ubayy ibn Kaʿb was sitting, when Abū Mūsā al-Ashʿarī came to us terrified — or he said: alarmed. We said: What is the matter with you? He said: ʿUmar sent for me for some need and I came to him; I asked permission three times and was not permitted, so I returned. I said to him: I heard the Messenger of God ﷺ say: “When one of you asks permission three times and is not permitted, let him return.” ʿUmar said: You will bring proof for what you say, or I will do such and such to you. Ubayy ibn Kaʿb said to me: No one will stand with you but the youngest of the people. Saʿīd [sic] said: I was the youngest of the people, so I went to ʿUmar and told him that the Messenger of God ﷺ said: “When one of you asks permission three times and is not permitted, let him return.”

narrators.ar: عَمْرُو بْنُ يَحْيَى بْنِ عُمَارَةَ بْنِ أَبِي الْحَسَنِ الْمَازِنِيُّ
narrators.en: ʿAmr ibn Yaḥyā ibn ʿUmāra ibn Abī al-Ḥasan al-Māzinī

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا عَمْرُو بْنُ يَحْيَى بْنِ عُمَارَةَ بْنِ أَبِي الْحَسَنِ الْمَازِنِيُّ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي أَبِي، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيَّ، يَقُولُ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم:
records.matn_ar: «وَلَيْسَ فِيمَا دُونَ خَمْسِ ذَوْدٍ صَدَقَةٌ، وَلَيْسَ فِيمَا دُونَ خَمْسَةِ أَوْسُقٍ صَدَقَةٌ، وَلَيْسَ فِيمَا دُونَ خَمْسَةِ أَوَاقٍ صَدَقَةٌ» ، قَالَ سُفْيَانُ: وَكَانَ عَمْرُو بْنُ دِينَارٍ، وَيَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، يَرْوِيَانِ هَذَا الْحَدِيثَ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ يَحْيَى
records.isnad_en: Al-Ḥumaydī narrated to us, he said: Sufyān narrated to us, he said: ʿAmr ibn Yaḥyā ibn ʿUmāra ibn Abī al-Ḥasan al-Māzinī narrated to us, he said: My father informed me that he heard Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī say:
records.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ said: “There is no zakāt on less than five camels (dhawd), no zakāt on less than five wasqs, and no zakāt on less than five ounces (awāq) [of silver].” Sufyān said: ʿAmr ibn Dīnār and Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd both used to narrate this ḥadīth from ʿAmr ibn Yaḥyā.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا صَفْوَانُ بْنُ سُلَيْمٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: «الْغُسْلُ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ وَاجِبٌ عَلَى كُلِّ مُحْتَلِمٍ»
records.isnad_en: Al-Ḥumaydī narrated to us, he said: Sufyān narrated to us, he said: Ṣafwān ibn Sulaym narrated to us, from ʿAṭāʾ ibn Yasār, from Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī, that
records.matn_en: the Messenger of God ﷺ said: “Ghusl on Friday is obligatory on every adult (muḥtalim).”

narrators.ar: الْعَلَاءُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ يَعْقُوبَ، مَوْلَى الْحُرَقَةِ
narrators.en: al-ʿAlāʾ ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Yaʿqūb, freedman of al-Ḥuraqa

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثني الْعَلَاءُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ يَعْقُوبَ، مَوْلَى الْحُرَقَةِ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ أَبِي، يَقُولُ:
records.matn_ar: أَتَيْتُ أَبَا سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيَّ، فَسَأَلْتُهُ هَلْ سَمِعْتَ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الْإِزَارِ شَيْئًا؟ فَقَالَ: نَعَمْ، تَعَلَّمْ، سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، يَقُولُ: «إِزْرَةُ الْمُؤْمِنِ إِلَى أَنْصَافِ سَاقَيْهِ، لَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْهِ فِيمَا بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ الْكَعْبَيْنِ، مَا أَسْفَلَ مِنَ الْكَعْبَيْنِ فِي النَّارِ، لَا يَنْظُرُ اللَّهُ عز وجل إِلَى مَنْ جَرَّ إِزَارَهُ بَطَرًا»
records.isnad_en: Al-Ḥumaydī narrated to us, he said: Sufyān narrated to us, he said: al-ʿAlāʾ ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Yaʿqūb, freedman of al-Ḥuraqa, narrated to me, he said: I heard my father say:
records.matn_en: I came to Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī and asked him: Have you heard anything from the Messenger of God ﷺ about the izār? He said: Yes — learn it: I heard the Messenger of God ﷺ say: “The believer’s izār reaches to the middle of his shins; there is no blame on him for what is between that and the ankles; what is below the ankles is in the Fire. God Almighty will not look at one who drags his izār in arrogance (baṭaran).”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا سُهَيْلُ بْنُ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ بْنِ بُشَيْرٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ الْأَعْشَى، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم:
records.matn_ar: «مَنْ كَانَ لَهُ ثَلَاثُ بَنَاتٍ، أَوْ ثَلَاثُ أَخَواتٍ، أَوِ ابْنَتَانِ، أَوْ أُخْتَانِ، فَأَحْسَنَ صُحْبَتَهُنَّ، وَصَبَرَ عَلَيْهِنَّ، وَاتَّقَى اللَّهَ فِيهِنَّ، دَخَلَ الْجَنَّةَ»
records.isnad_en: Al-Ḥumaydī narrated to us, he said: Sufyān narrated to us, he said: Suhayl ibn Abī Ṣāliḥ narrated to us, from Ayyūb ibn Bashīr, from Saʿīd al-Aʿshā, from Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
records.matn_en: “Whoever has three daughters, or three sisters, or two daughters or two sisters, and treats them well, is patient with them and fears God regarding them, enters Paradise.”

narrators.ar: يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَأَبُو عُمَيْرٍ الْحَارِثُ بْنُ عُمَيْرٍ

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَأَبُو عُمَيْرٍ الْحَارِثُ بْنُ عُمَيْرٍ،
records.matn_ar: أَنَّهُمَا سَمِعَا مِنْ أَبِي طُوَالَةَ يُحَدِّثُ، عَنْ نَهَّارٍ الْعَبْدِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، يَقُولُ: " إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَيَسْأَلُ الْعَبْدَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ حَتَّى يَقُولَ: مَا مَنَعَكَ إِذَا رَأَيْتَ الْمُنْكَرِ فِي الدُّنْيَا أَنْ تَكْرَهَ، فَإِذَا لَقَّنَ اللَّهُ عز وجل عَبْدَهُ حُجَّتَهُ، قَالَ: يَا رَبِّ رَجَوْتُكَ وَخِفْتُ النَّاسَ "
records.isnad_en: Al-Ḥumaydī narrated to us, he said: Sufyān narrated to us, he said: Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd and Abū ʿUmayr al-Ḥārith ibn ʿUmayr narrated to us, that both heard Abū Ṭuwāla narrate, from Nahhār al-ʿAbdī, from Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī, who said: I heard the Messenger of God ﷺ say:
records.matn_en: “God will question the servant on the Day of Resurrection until He says: What prevented you, when you saw the wrong in the world, from disapproving of it? And when God Almighty prompts His servant with his argument, he says: My Lord, I hoped in You and feared people.”

narrators.ar: عِيَاضَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي سَرْحٍ الْعَامِرِيَّ
narrators.en: ʿIyāḍ ibn ʿAbd Allāh ibn Saʿd ibn Abī Sarḥ al-ʿĀmirī

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَجْلَانَ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ عِيَاضَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي سَرْحٍ الْعَامِرِيَّ، يَقُولُ: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيَّ، يَقُولُ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم
records.matn_ar: عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ: «أَنَّ أَخْوَفَ مَا أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ مَا يُخْرِجُ اللَّهُ عز وجل مِنْ نَبَاتِ الْأَرْضِ، وَزَهْرَةُ الدُّنْيَا» ، قَالَ: فَقَامَ رَجُلٌ، فَقَالَ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ وَهَلْ يَأْتِي الْخَيْرُ بِالشَّرِّ؟ ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ، قَالَ: فَسَكَتَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَتَّى رَأَيْنَا أَنَّهُ يُنَزَّلُ عَلَيْهِ، وَكَانَ إِذَا أُنْزِلَ عَلَيْهِ غَشِيَهُ بُهْرٌ وَعَرَقٌ، فَلَمَّا سُرِّيَ عَنْهُ، قَالَ: «أَيْنَ السَّائِلُ؟» ⦗ص: 10⦘ قَالَ: هَا أَنَا ذَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، صلى الله عليه وسلم، وَلَمْ أُرِدْ إِلَّا خَيْرًا، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «إِنَّ الْخَيْرَ لَا يَأْتِي إِلَّا بِالْخَيْرِ، إِنَّ الْخَيْرَ لَا يَأْتِي إِلَّا بِالْخَيْرِ، إِنَّ الْخَيْرَ لَا يَأْتِي إِلَّا بِالْخَيْرِ، وَلَكِنَّ الدُّنْيَا خَضِرَةٌ حُلْوَةٌ، وَكُلُّ مَا يُنْبِتُ الرَّبِيعُ يُقْتَلُ حَبَطًا، أَوْ يُلِمُّ إِلَّا آكِلَةُ الْخَضِرِ، تَأْكُلُ حَتَّى إِذَا امْتَدَّتْ خَاصِرَتَاهَا اسْتَقْبَلَتِ الشَّمْسَ، فَثَلَطَتْ أَوْ بَالَتْ، ثُمَّ عَادَتْ فَأَكَلَتْ، ثُمَّ أَفَاضَتْ فَاجْتَرَّتْ، مَنْ أَخَذَ مَالًا بِحَقِّهِ بُورِكَ لَهُ فِيهِ، وَمَنْ أَخَذَ مَالًا بِغَيْرِ حَقِّهِ لَمْ يُبَارَكْ لَهُ فِيهِ، وَكَانَ كَالَّذِي يَأْكُلُ وَلَا يَشْبَعُ، وَالْيَدُ الْعُلْيَا خَيْرٌ مِنَ الْيَدِ السُّفْلَى» قَالَ سُفْيَانُ: «كَثِيرًا مَا كَانَ الْأَعْمَشُ يَسْتَعِيدُنِي هَذَا الْحَدِيثَ كُلَّمَا جِئْتُهُ»
records.isnad_en: Al-Ḥumaydī narrated to us, he said: Sufyān narrated to us, he said: Muḥammad ibn ʿAjlān narrated to us that he heard ʿIyāḍ ibn ʿAbd Allāh ibn Saʿd ibn Abī Sarḥ al-ʿĀmirī say: I heard Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī say:
records.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ said on the pulpit: “The thing I fear most for you is what God Almighty brings forth for you of the growth of the earth, and the splendor of this world.” He said: A man stood up and said: O Messenger of God, does good bring evil? — three times. He said: The Messenger of God ﷺ fell silent until we thought that revelation was descending on him; and when revelation descended on him, he was overcome by shortness of breath and sweat. When it lifted from him, he said: “Where is the questioner?” [p. 10] He said: Here I am, O Messenger of God ﷺ — and I meant only good. The Messenger of God ﷺ said: “Good brings only good; good brings only good; good brings only good. But this world is green and sweet, and everything the spring grows kills by bloating or comes near to it, except the eater of greens (ākilat al-khaḍir): it eats until, when its flanks are full, it faces the sun, and dungs or urinates, then returns and eats; then it surges forth and chews its cud. Whoever takes wealth by right is blessed in it; and whoever takes wealth without right is not blessed in it, and is like one who eats and is never satisfied. And the upper hand is better than the lower hand.” Sufyān said: “Often al-Aʿmash would ask me to repeat this ḥadīth whenever I came to him.”

narrators.ar: عِيَاضُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي سَرْحٍ
narrators.en: ʿIyāḍ ibn ʿAbd Allāh ibn Saʿd ibn Abī Sarḥ

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَجْلَانَ، قَالَ: ثنا عِيَاضُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي سَرْحٍ،
records.matn_ar: قَالَ ⦗ص: 11⦘ : رَأَيْتُ أَبَا سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيَّ، جَاءَ وَمَرْوَانُ بْنُ الْحَكَمِ يَخْطُبُ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ، فَقَامَ يُصَلِّي الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ، فَجَاءَ إِلَيْهِ الْأَحْرَاسُ لِيُجْلِسُوهُ، فَأَبَى أَنْ يَجْلِسَ حَتَّى صَلَّى الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ، فَلَمَّا قَضَى الصَّلَاةَ أَتَيْنَاهُ، فَقُلْنَا لَهُ: يَا أَبَا سَعِيدٍ كَادَ هَؤُلَاءِ أَنْ يَفْعَلُوا بِكَ، فَقَالَ أَبُو سَعِيدٍ: مَا كُنْتُ لِأَدَعَهُمَا لِشَيْءٍ بَعْدَ شَيْءٍ رَأَيْتُهُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَجَاءَ رَجُلٌ وَهُوَ يَخْطُبُ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ، فَدَخَلَ الْمَسْجِدَ بِهَيْئَةٍ بَذَّةٍ، فَقَالَ لَهُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «أَصَلَّيْتَ» ؟ قَالَ: لَا، قَالَ: «فَصَلِّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ» ، ثُمَّ حَثَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم النَّاسَ عَلَى الصَّدَقَةِ، فَأَلْقَى النَّاسُ ثِيَابًا، فَأَعْطَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الرَّجُلَ مِنْهَا ثَوْبَيْنِ، فَلَمَّا جَاءَتِ الْجُمُعَةُ الْأُخْرَى، جَاءَ الرَّجُلُ وَالنَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَخْطُبُ، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «هَلْ صَلَّيْتَ رَكْعَتَيْنِ؟» قَالَ: لَا، قَالَ: «فَصَلِّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ» ، ثُمَّ حَثَّ النَّاسَ عَلَى الصَّدَقَةِ، فَأَلْقَوْا ثِيَابًا، فَأَعْطَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الرَّجُلَ مِنْهَا ثَوْبَيْنِ، فَلَمَّا جَاءَتِ الْجُمُعَةُ الْأُخْرَى، جَاءَ الرَّجُلُ وَالنَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَخْطُبُ، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «هَلْ صَلَّيْتَ رَكْعَتَيْنِ؟» قَالَ: لَا، قَالَ: «فَصَلِّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ» ، ثُمَّ حَثَّ النَّاسَ عَلَى الصَّدَقَةِ، فَأَلْقَوْا ثِيَابًا، فَطَرَحَ الرَّجُلُ أَحَدَ ثَوْبَيْهِ، فَصَاحَ بِهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، وَقَالَ: «خُذْهُ، فَأَخَذَهُ» ، ثُمَّ قَالَ: " انْظُرُوا إِلَى هَذَا، جَاءَ تِلْكَ الْجُمُعَةَ بِهَيْئَةٍ بَذَّةٍ، فَأَمَرْتُ النَّاسَ بِالصَّدَقَةِ، فَأَلْقَوْا ثِيَابًا، فَأَعْطَيْتُهُ مِنْهَا ثَوْبَيْنِ، فَلَمَّا جَاءَتْ هَذِهِ الْجُمُعَةُ أَمَرْتُ النَّاسَ بِالصَّدَقَةِ، فَأَلْقَى أَحَدَ ثَوْبَيْهِ، قَالَ سُفْيَانُ: يَقُولُ: لَا صَدَقَةَ إِلَّا عَنْ ظَهْرِ غِنًى، وَلَا غِنًى بِهَذَا عَنْ ثَوْبِهِ "
records.isnad_en: Al-Ḥumaydī narrated to us, he said: Sufyān narrated to us, he said: Muḥammad ibn ʿAjlān narrated to us, he said: ʿIyāḍ ibn ʿAbd Allāh ibn Saʿd ibn Abī Sarḥ narrated to us, he said
records.matn_en: [p. 11]: I saw Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī come while Marwān ibn al-Ḥakam was preaching on Friday. He stood and prayed two rakʿas; the guards came to him to make him sit, but he refused to sit until he had prayed the two rakʿas. When the prayer was over we went to him and said to him: O Abū Saʿīd, they nearly did something to you. Abū Saʿīd said: I would not abandon them for anything, after something I saw from the Messenger of God ﷺ. I saw the Messenger of God ﷺ when a man came while he was preaching on Friday, and he entered the mosque in a shabby state, and the Prophet ﷺ said to him: “Have you prayed?” He said: No. He said: “Then pray two rakʿas.” Then the Messenger of God ﷺ urged the people to give charity, and the people threw down garments, and the Messenger of God ﷺ gave the man two garments of them. When the next Friday came, the man came while the Prophet ﷺ was preaching, and the Prophet ﷺ said: “Have you prayed two rakʿas?” He said: No. He said: “Then pray two rakʿas.” Then he urged the people to give charity, and they threw down garments, and the Messenger of God ﷺ gave the man two garments of them. When the next Friday came, the man came while the Prophet ﷺ was preaching, and the Prophet ﷺ said: “Have you prayed two rakʿas?” He said: No. He said: “Then pray two rakʿas.” Then he urged the people to give charity, and they threw down garments, and the man threw down one of his two garments; the Messenger of God ﷺ called out to him and said: “Take it,” and he took it. Then he said: “Look at this man. He came on that Friday in a shabby state, and I ordered the people to give charity, and they threw down garments, and I gave him two of them; and when this Friday came, I ordered the people to give charity, and he threw down one of his two garments.” Sufyān said: He means: “There is no charity except from surplus wealth (ʿan ẓahri ghinā), and this man has no surplus beyond his garment.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا ابْنُ عَجْلَانَ،
records.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ عِيَاضَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، يَقُولُ ⦗ص: 12⦘ : سَمِعْتُ أَبَا سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيَّ، يَقُولُ: «مَا كُنَّا نُخْرِجُ عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي زَكَاةِ الْفِطْرِ إِلَّا صَاعًا مِنْ تَمْرٍ، أَوْ صَاعًا مِنْ شَعِيرٍ، أَوْ صَاعًا مِنْ أَقِطٍ»
records.isnad_en: Al-Ḥumaydī narrated to us, he said: Sufyān narrated to us, he said: Ibn ʿAjlān narrated to us
records.matn_en: that he heard ʿIyāḍ ibn ʿAbd Allāh say [p. 12]: I heard Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī say: “We used to give, in the time of the Messenger of God ﷺ, as zakāt al-fiṭr only a ṣāʿ of dates, or a ṣāʿ of barley, or a ṣāʿ of dried cheese (aqiṭ).”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا عَمْرُو بْنُ دِينَارٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، يَقُولُ: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيُّ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم:
records.matn_ar: " يَأْتِي عَلَى النَّاسِ زَمَانٌ، فَيَغْزُو فِيهِ فِئَامٌ مِنَ النَّاسِ، فَيُقَالُ: هَلْ فِيكُمْ مَنْ صَحِبَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم؟ فَيُقَالُ: نَعَمْ، فَيُفْتَحُ لَهُمْ، ثُمَّ يَأْتِي عَلَى النَّاسِ زَمَانٌ، فَيَغْزُو فِيهِ فِئَامٌ مِنَ النَّاسِ، فَيُقَالُ لَهُمْ: هَلْ فِيكُمْ مَنْ صَحِبَ أَصْحَابَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم؟ فَيُقَالُ لَهُمْ: نَعَمْ، فَيُفْتَحُ لَهُمْ، ثُمَّ يَأْتِي عَلَى النَّاسِ زَمَانٌ، فَيَغْزُو فِيهِ فِئَامٌ مِنَ النَّاسِ، فَيُقَالُ: هَلْ فِيكُمْ مَنْ صَحِبَ مَنْ صَاحَبَ أَصْحَابَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم؟ فَيُقَالُ: نَعَمْ، فَيُفْتَحُ لَهُمْ "
records.isnad_en: Al-Ḥumaydī narrated to us, he said: Sufyān narrated to us, he said: ʿAmr ibn Dīnār narrated to us
records.matn_en: that he heard Jābir ibn ʿAbd Allāh say: Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī narrated to me, he said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said: “A time will come upon the people when a large group of people will go on a campaign, and it will be said: Is there among you anyone who accompanied the Messenger of God ﷺ? It will be said: Yes — and victory will be granted to them. Then a time will come upon the people when a large group will go on a campaign, and it will be said to them: Is there among you anyone who accompanied the companions of the Messenger of God ﷺ? It will be said to them: Yes — and victory will be granted to them. Then a time will come upon the people when a large group will go on a campaign, and it will be said: Is there among you anyone who accompanied those who accompanied the companions of the Messenger of God ﷺ? It will be said: Yes — and victory will be granted to them.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا عَمْرُو بْنُ دِينَارِ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو صَالِحٍ السَّمَّانُ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيَّ،
records.matn_ar: يُحَدِّثُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، قَالَ: «الدِّرْهَمُ بِالدِّرْهَمُ، وَالدِّينَارُ بِالدِّينَارِ، مِثْلَا بِمِثْلٍ، لَيْسَ بَيْنَهُمَا فَضْلٌ» ، فَقُلْتُ لِأَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ: فَإِنَّ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ لَا يَرَى بِهِ بَأْسًا
records.isnad_en: Al-Ḥumaydī narrated to us, he said: Sufyān narrated to us, he said: ʿAmr ibn Dīnār narrated to us, he said: Abū Ṣāliḥ al-Sammān informed me, he said: I heard Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī narrate that
records.matn_en: the Messenger of God ﷺ said: “The dirham for the dirham, the dinar for the dinar, like for like, with no surplus between them.” I said to Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī: But Ibn ʿAbbās sees no harm in it.

continuations.text_en: Abū Saʿīd said: I met Ibn ʿAbbās and said to him: Inform me about this which you say — is it something you found in the Book of God, or something you heard from the Messenger of God ﷺ? He said: I did not find it in the Book of God, nor did I hear it from the Messenger of God ﷺ, and you know the Messenger of God ﷺ better than I do; but Usāma ibn Zayd informed me that the Messenger of God ﷺ said: “Usury (ribā) is in credit (nasīʾa).”
continuations.text_ar: فَقَالَ أَبُو سَعِيدٍ: قَدْ لَقِيتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ، فَقُلْتُ لَهُ: أَخْبِرْنِي عَنْ هَذَا الَّذِي تَقُولُ، أَشَيْءٌ وَجَدْتَهُ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ؟ أَوْ شَيْءٌ سَمِعْتَهُ مَنِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم؟ فَقَالَ: مَا وَجَدْتُهُ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ، وَلَا سَمِعْتُهُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، وَلَأَنْتُمْ أَعْلَمُ بِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنِّي، وَلَكِنْ أَخْبَرَنِي أُسَامَةُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، قَالَ: «الرِّبَا فِي النَّسِيئَةِ»

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا ضَمْرَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الْمَازِنِيُّ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيَّ يُحَدِّثُ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بِحَدِيثِ الصَّرْفِ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم،
records.matn_ar: وَجَاءَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ، فَسَأَلَهُ عَنْهُ وَأَنَا حَاضِرٌ، قَالَ سُفْيَانُ: إِنِّي لَا أَحْفَظُ شَيْئًا فِيهِ إِلَّا أَنَّهُ نَحْوٌ مِمَّا يُحَدِّثُ النَّاسُ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم «فِي الذَّهَبِ بِالذَّهَبِ مِثْلًا بِمِثْلٍ، الْوَرِقُ بِالْوَرِقِ مِثْلًا بِمِثْلٍ»
records.isnad_en: Al-Ḥumaydī narrated to us, he said: Sufyān narrated to us, he said: Ḍamra ibn Saʿīd al-Māzinī narrated to us, he said: I heard Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī narrate from ʿUmar the ḥadīth of exchange (ṣarf) from the Messenger of God ﷺ, and Ibn ʿUmar came and asked him about it while I was present. Sufyān said:
records.matn_en: I do not remember anything of it, except that it was similar to what people narrate from Abū Saʿīd, from the Prophet ﷺ: “Gold for gold, like for like; silver for silver, like for like.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِيهِ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ التَّيْمِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: أَوْقَفْتُ جَارِيَةً لِي أَبِيعُهَا فِي سُوقِ بَنِي قَيْنُقَاعٍ، فَجَاءَنِي رَجُلٌ مِنَ الْيَهُودِ، فَقَالَ: يَا أَبَا سَعِيدٍ، مَا هَذِهِ الْجَارِيَةُ؟ قُلْتُ: جَارِيَةٌ لِي أَبِيعُهَا، قَالَ: فَلَعَلَّكَ أَنْ تَبِيعَهَا وَفِي بَطْنِهَا مِنْكَ سَخْلَةٌ، قُلْتُ: إِنِّي كُنْتُ أَعْزِلُ عَنْهَا، قَالَ: فَإِنَّ تِلْكَ الْمَوْءُودَةُ الصُّغْرَى، فَأَتَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَذَكَرْتُ ذَلِكَ لَهُ، فَقَالَ: «كَذَبَتْ يَهُودُ، وَلَا عَلَيْكُمْ أَلَّا تَفْعَلُوا»
records.isnad_en: Al-Ḥumaydī narrated to us, he said: Sufyān narrated to us, he said:
records.matn_en: Muḥammad ibn Isḥāq narrated it to me, from Muḥammad ibn Ibrāhīm al-Taymī, from Abū Salama ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān, from Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī, who said: I had a slave woman standing for sale in the market of Banū Qaynuqāʿ, and a man of the Jews came to me and said: O Abū Saʿīd, what is this slave woman? I said: My slave woman, whom I am selling. He said: Perhaps you will sell her while in her belly is a lamb (sakhla) of yours. I said: I used to practice withdrawal (ʿazl) with her. He said: That is the lesser infanticide (al-mawʾūda al-ṣughrā). So I went to the Messenger of God ﷺ and mentioned that to him, and he said: “The Jews have lied; and there is no blame upon you that you not do [it]” (lit.: “it is not upon you that you not do”).

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا ابْنُ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنْ قَزَعَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، أَنَّ الْعَزْلَ ذُكِرَ عِنْدَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: «فَلِمَ يَفْعَلُ ذَلِكَ أَحَدُكُمْ» ، وَلَمْ يَقُلْ: «فَلَا يَفْعَلْ ذَلِكَ أَحَدُكُمْ، فَإِنَّهَا لَيْسَتْ نَفْسٌ مَخْلُوقَةً إِلَّا اللَّهُ خَالِقُهَا»
records.isnad_en: Al-Ḥumaydī narrated to us, he said: Sufyān narrated to us, he said: Ibn Abī Najīḥ narrated to us, from Mujāhid, from Qazaʿa, from Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī, that
records.matn_en: withdrawal (ʿazl) was mentioned in the presence of the Prophet ﷺ, and he said: “Why would one of you do that?” — and he did not say: “Let not one of you do that, for there is no soul that has been created but that God is its Creator.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا مُجَالِدٌ، عَنْ أَبِي الْوَدَّاكِ جَبْرِ بْنِ نَوْفٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم،
records.matn_ar: نَحْوَهُ
records.isnad_en: Al-Ḥumaydī narrated to us, he said: Sufyān narrated to us, he said: Mujālid narrated to us, from Abū al-Wadāk Jabr ibn Nawf, from Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī, from the Prophet ﷺ,
records.matn_en: similarly.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا عَلِيُّ بْنُ زَيْدِ بْنِ جُدْعَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم:
records.matn_ar: «لَا تَقُومُ السَّاعَةُ حَتَّى تَقْتَتِلَ ⦗ص: 16⦘ فِئَتَانِ عَظِيمَتَانِ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ دَعْوَاهُمَا وَاحِدَةٌ، أَوْلَاهُمَا بِالْحَقِّ الَّتِي تَغْلِبُ، فَبَيْنَمَا هُمْ كَذَلِكَ، إِذْ مَرَقَتْ مِنْهُمْ مَارِقَةٌ، يَمْرُقُونَ مِنَ الدِّينِ، كَمَا يَمْرُقُ السَّهْمُ مِنَ الرَّمِيَّةِ»
records.isnad_en: Al-Ḥumaydī narrated to us, he said: Sufyān narrated to us, he said: ʿAlī ibn Zayd ibn Judʿān narrated to us, from Abū Naḍra, from Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
records.matn_en: “The Hour will not come until two great groups of Muslims fight each other [p. 16], whose claim is one; the nearer of the two to the truth is the one that prevails. While they are thus, a deviating party will break away from them — they will pass out of the religion as the arrow passes through the quarry.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ عُمَيْرٍ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي قَزَعَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: «لَا تُشَدُّ الرِّحَالُ إِلَّا إِلَى ثَلَاثَةِ مَسَاجِدَ، الْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ، وَمَسْجِدِي هَذَا، وَمَسْجِدِ إِيلْيَا»
